items.title: 南俊國際通用伺服器缺料緩解 Q2將是今年最低點 VR、ASIC滑軌Q3放量
items.title_en: Nan Jun International General Server Material Shortage Eases, Q2 Will Be Year’s Low Point, VR and ASIC Slides Ramp Up in Q3
paras: 伺服器滑軌廠南俊國際(6584-TW)今(27)日參加櫃買業績發表會，總經理特助暨代理發言人任忠仁表示，受惠於通用型伺服器供應鏈缺料問題逐步緩解，加上輝達Vera Rubin系列滑軌與美系CSP客戶的ASIC滑軌於第3季正式啟動量產，第2季營運已確立為全年谷底，後續將重回逐季成長軌道。
任忠仁提到，先前輝達GB系列因新產品導入與認證進度落後同業，以及通用伺服器因零組件缺料，導致第2季出貨與市占受限，但次世代Vera Rubin系列滑軌開發時程已全面跟上，預計於8月啟動少量出貨並在9月放量交付一線雲端大廠，隨著高階AI伺服器滑軌出貨比重拉升，將進一步帶動平均銷售單價與毛利率向上成長。
產能分配部分，任忠仁指出，目前越南租賃廠兩條Eagle Stream產線維持滿載，Birch Stream產線持續進行自動化改善，預計第4季將再導入4U儲存機櫃與隱藏式滑軌專用線；自建的越南新廠正進行建照申請，預計於明年底完工，屆時整體產線規模將可擴充至20條。
任忠仁提到，受惠於大客戶落實非台灣與非中國產能政策，越南廠第2季占合併營收比重已達20%，第3季有望突破30%，憑藉當地材料成本比台灣便宜2-3成及匯率優勢，有效支撐毛利率表現。
面對同業競爭，任忠仁表示，南俊建立極為嚴謹的智財管理機制，由專職工程師每月份成三組定期監控同業專利動態，若遇相似設計均先委託外部專利事務所進行鑑定以確保避開侵權風險。為大幅加速新產品導入時程，目前在VR世代與同業的進度差距已顯著縮小至一季以內。
任忠仁指出，GB300滑軌報價區間約為60至70美元，新一代VR滑軌報價則落在70至80美元。相較於過去在GB系列開發速度落後同業，公司在VR世代已建立30多種截面規格與豐富專利庫，大幅縮短客製化開發時程三至六個月，並在雲科三廠建立專線以加速量產節奏。
產品占比部分，南俊國際今年上半年每股純益近6.5元。上半年伺服器產品占整體營收比重達70%，其中純GB系列占營收約5%，若加計交換器與其他AI相關產品在內的泛AI比重則落在15%至20%之間。
paras_en: Nan Jun International (6584‑TW) attended today’s (27th) OTC earnings briefing. Assistant General Manager and acting spokesperson Ren Zhong‑ren said the company is benefiting from the gradual easing of material shortages in the generic server supply chain, and with Nvidia’s Vera Rubin series slides and U.S. CSP customers’ ASIC slides entering mass production in Q3, Q2 operations have been confirmed as the annual trough, after which the company will return to a quarter‑by‑quarter growth trajectory.

Ren noted that Nvidia’s GB series had previously lagged peers in new product introduction and certification, and generic servers faced component shortages, limiting Q2 shipments and market share. However, the development schedule for the next‑generation Vera Rubin slides is now fully on track, with a small‑volume launch expected in August and volume deliveries to major cloud providers slated for September. As the share of high‑end AI server slides rises, average selling price and gross margin are expected to improve further.

Regarding capacity allocation, Ren said the two Eagle Stream production lines at the leased Vietnam plant are running at full capacity, while the Birch Stream line is undergoing automation upgrades. A dedicated line for 4U storage cabinets and hidden slides is planned for Q4. The company’s own new Vietnam facility is currently applying for a construction permit and is expected to be completed by the end of next year, at which point total production capacity could expand to 20 lines.

Ren added that, thanks to major customers implementing non‑Taiwan and non‑China capacity policies, the Vietnam plant already accounted for 20% of consolidated revenue in Q2 and is expected to exceed 30% in Q3. Lower local material costs—20‑30% cheaper than in Taiwan—and favorable exchange rates are helping sustain gross‑margin performance.

Facing industry competition, Ren said Nan Jun has established a rigorous intellectual‑property management system, with three teams of dedicated engineers monitoring competitors’ patents monthly. When similar designs are identified, external patent firms are engaged for clearance to avoid infringement risk. To accelerate new‑product introductions, the gap with peers in the VR generation has been narrowed to less than one quarter.

Ren indicated that the GB300 slide is priced between US$60 and US$70, while the new‑generation VR slide ranges from US$70 to US$80. Compared with the slower GB‑series development in the past, the VR generation now boasts over 30 cross‑section specifications and a rich patent portfolio, cutting custom development time by three to six months, and a dedicated line at CloudTech Plant 3 has been set up to speed up mass production.

In terms of product mix, Nan Jun International reported earnings per share of nearly NT$6.5 for the first half of the year. Server products accounted for 70% of total revenue in H1, with the pure GB series contributing about 5% of revenue. Including switches and other AI‑related products, the broader AI segment represents 15%‑20% of revenue.

items.title: 〈景氣燈號〉連亮8紅！41分持平、製造業回溫 經濟動能穩健但要留意4大不確定
items.title_en: Economic Indicator Lights Show 8 Consecutive Reds! Index Holds at 41, Manufacturing Warmed Up – Growth Momentum Steady but Watch Four Major Uncertainties
paras: 國發會今（27）日公布116年7月景氣對策信號，綜合判斷分數為41分，與上周持平，燈號續亮紅燈，呈現連續第8個紅燈。其中，製造業營業氣候測驗點受惠AI需求持續強勁，由綠燈轉呈黃紅燈；貨幣總計數M1B受外資淨匯出影響，由黃紅燈轉為綠燈；另領先及同時指標持續上升，顯示國內經濟成長動能相當穩健；但仍需留意中東情勢發展、美國關稅政策變化、主要國家貨幣政策動向及財政不確定性等因素影響。
9項構成項目中，製造業營業氣候測驗點由上月98.61點增至101.09點，增加1分，燈號由綠燈轉呈黃紅燈；貨幣總計數M1B變動率由9.4%降至7.3%，減少1分，燈號由黃紅燈轉為綠燈。其餘7項燈號維持不變，包括股價指數、工業生產指數、海關出口值、機械及電機設備進口值、製造業銷售量指數、批發零售及餐飲業營業額等6項續呈紅燈，工業及服務業加班工時變動率則續呈黃紅燈。
指標方面，7月領先指標不含趨勢指數為104.63，周增0.72%，7個構成項目中有5項上升，包括外銷訂單動向指數、股價指數、實質半導體設備進口值、製造業營業氣候測驗點及實質貨幣總計數M1B；同時指標不含趨勢指數為106.80，周增0.36%，批發零售及餐飲業營業額、工業生產指數、製造業銷售量指數與電力總用電量等4項均呈現上升。
展望未來，國發會指出，隨著AI應用深化推升算力需求，全球主要雲端服務商加速AI基礎建設，加上消費性電子新品進入備貨階段，出口可望延續成長態勢。投資方面，國內半導體及AI供應鏈積極擴產，國際大廠亦擴大在台投資與採購，加上政府推動中小微及傳統產業轉型升級，均有助民間投資擴增。
消費方面，上市櫃企業獲利良好，增添加薪及股利發放意願，加以就業市場穩健、車市買氣回溫，皆可望活絡消費。惟國際經貿仍受中東情勢發展、美國關稅政策變化、主要國家貨幣政策動向及財政不確定性等因素影響，仍須密切留意後續發展。
paras_en: The National Development Council released the July 2023 economic policy signal today (27th), with a composite score of 41 points, unchanged from last week. The signal light remains red for the eighth consecutive time. Among the components, the manufacturing business climate index, boosted by strong AI demand, shifted from green to a yellow‑red light; the total money supply M1B, affected by net foreign‑exchange outflows, moved from a yellow‑red light to green. Leading and coincident indicators continue to rise, indicating that domestic growth momentum remains robust, though attention is needed for developments in the Middle East, changes in U.S. tariff policy, major countries’ monetary policy directions, and fiscal uncertainties.

Of the nine constituent items, the manufacturing business climate index rose from 98.61 last month to 101.09, a one‑point increase, changing its light from green to yellow‑red. The M1B growth rate fell from 9.4% to 7.3%, a one‑point drop, turning its light from yellow‑red to green. The other seven lights stayed the same: the stock‑price index, industrial production index, customs export value, imports of machinery and electrical equipment, manufacturing sales index, and wholesale‑retail‑restaurant sales all remain red, while the change rate of overtime hours in industry and services stays yellow‑red.

On the indicator side, the July leading index excluding the trend component was 104.63, up 0.72% week‑over‑week, with five of its seven components rising – the export orders index, stock‑price index, real semiconductor equipment imports, manufacturing business climate index, and real M1B. The coincident index excluding the trend component was 106.80, up 0.36% week‑over‑week, with four components – wholesale‑retail‑restaurant sales, industrial production index, manufacturing sales index and total electricity consumption – all increasing.

Looking ahead, the council noted that deeper AI applications are driving higher computing‑power demand, prompting major global cloud providers to accelerate AI infrastructure build‑out. Combined with consumer‑electronics new‑product stock‑building, exports are expected to keep growing. On the investment side, domestic semiconductor and AI supply chains are expanding capacity, foreign giants are increasing investment and procurement in Taiwan, and government‑led upgrades of SMEs and traditional industries should further boost private investment.

On the consumption side, listed companies are posting solid profits, increasing willingness to raise wages and pay dividends. Coupled with a sturdy labor market and a warming auto market, consumer activity is likely to pick up. Nevertheless, international trade remains vulnerable to Middle‑East developments, U.S. tariff policy shifts, major economies’ monetary policy moves and fiscal uncertainties, which require close monitoring.

items.title: 法國拋註銷18%公債訴求！全球恐走向「憑空抹債」加劇通膨
items.title_en: France Calls for Writing Off 18% of Public Debt! Global Fear of “Phantom Debt Erasure” Fuels Inflation
paras: 全球長天期公債殖利率持續攀升，高負債壓力也催生激進的「取消債務」主張。知名總體策略師、Variant Perception共同創辦人賽門懷特（Simon White）警告，這類思潮可能由法國蔓延至其他國家，全球債務週期恐步入透過貨幣融資「憑空抹債」的階段，最終恐加劇通膨並導致金融資產貶值。
懷特指出，全球金融危機時期的經典場景正在重演。法國左翼民粹派政治人物梅朗雄近期呼籲註銷該國18%的公共債務，甚至形容可將債券直接燒掉。類似主張並非首次出現，2009年歐債危機期間，歐洲和美國都曾出現相關討論。
問題在於，取消債務本質上只是另一種形式的貨幣融資，可能引發劇烈通膨，進一步強化「實體資產優於金融資產」的投資邏輯。
美國也曾提出類似構想。2011年，美國一度討論由財政部鑄造面額1兆美元的白金硬幣，再由聯準會以此兌換1兆美元政府債券，隨後由財政部註銷債券，以規避逼近的債務上限。
如今，美國距離再次觸及債務上限僅剩1.1兆美元，債務占國內生產毛額（GDP）比率則較15年前高出25個百分點，利息支出更已超過1兆美元。懷特認為，若美國政壇也出現要求註銷或削減部分公債的聲音，並不令人意外。
美國雙重赤字最令人憂心
懷特表示，美國的債務情勢仍是全球最令人擔憂的一環。以GDP占比計算，美國經常帳赤字與預算赤字合計的「雙重赤字」，規模超過除巴西以外的所有大型新興市場及已開發經濟體。
如此龐大的赤字，與美國目前所處的經濟週期並不相稱。部分原因來自利息支出激增，但即使排除利息負擔，美國無論以GDP占比或美元金額計算，仍擁有全球最大的赤字。
隨著西方政壇近年逐漸失去撤回財政刺激的意願，加上政治力量背離中間路線，轉向非傳統政策，取消債務等激進手段進入政治議程，已非無法想像。即使最終未付諸實施，這類低機率、高衝擊的尾部事件，也已改變市場的風險分布。
傳統減債選項愈來愈難
懷特認為，政府降低債務的方式包括財政整頓、經濟成長或通膨、金融壓抑、出售政府資產、債務違約或重組，以及取消債務或其他形式的貨幣融資。
然而，財政整頓可能在選舉中付出沉重代價；經濟成長受到龐大赤字拖累，通膨也因利息支出增加而升溫；金融壓抑即使終將出現，也可能為時已晚；出售黃金等政府資產則只是一次性措施，難以產生實質效果。相較之下，直接取消債務因執行相對容易，對政策制定者的吸引力可能日益上升。
「憑空抹債」恐引爆通膨
以美國為例，財政部可將聯準會持有的公債減記，例如削減10%，甚至直接註銷，再由聯準會把自身權益減記為負值。其他變形做法還包括鑄造白金硬幣、開放央行透支額度等，但本質都相同。
懷特指出，聯準會過去透過量化寬鬆（QE）創造的準備金，理應隨財政部償還到期債務而逐步註銷。一旦債務直接取消，準備金便失去回收時點，等同形成永久性的貨幣投放。
無論是配合財政擴張的QE、殖利率曲線控制，或由央行向財政部提供近乎無上限的融資，最終都可能推升通膨。只要各國繼續擱置痛苦但有效的財政改革，轉向取消債務等權宜手段，全球債務週期步入「憑空抹債」階段的尾部風險就將持續上升。
paras_en: Global long‑term sovereign bond yields keep climbing, and high debt burdens are spawning radical “debt cancellation” demands. Prominent macro strategist and Variant Perception co‑founder Simon White warned that this mindset could spread from France to other nations, pushing the world‑debt cycle into a phase of “phantom debt erasure” via monetary financing, ultimately worsening inflation and devaluing financial assets.

White noted that the classic scenario of a global financial crisis is replaying. France’s left‑wing populist politician Jean‑Luc Mélenchon recently called for writing off 18% of the country’s public debt, even suggesting the bonds could be burned outright. Similar proposals are not new; during the 2009 Euro‑debt crisis, comparable discussions surfaced in Europe and the United States.

The problem is that cancelling debt is essentially another form of monetary financing, which could spark severe inflation and further reinforce the investment logic that “real assets outrank financial assets.”

The United States has floated a similar idea. In 2011, there was a brief discussion about the Treasury minting a one‑trillion‑dollar platinum coin, which the Federal Reserve would exchange for one trillion dollars of government bonds, after which the Treasury would cancel the bonds to sidestep the looming debt ceiling.

Today the U.S. is only $1.1 trillion away from hitting the debt ceiling again, with debt‑to‑GDP ratios about 25 percentage points higher than 15 years ago, and interest outlays already exceeding $1 trillion. White believes it would not be surprising if voices in Washington also began demanding the write‑off or reduction of some sovereign debt.
The United States’ dual deficit is the most concerning

White said the U.S. debt situation remains the world’s biggest worry. Measured as a share of GDP, the combined “dual deficit” of the current‑account deficit and the budget deficit exceeds that of every large emerging market and developed economy except Brazil.

Such a massive deficit is out of sync with the U.S. economic cycle. Part of it stems from soaring interest costs, but even excluding interest burdens, the United States still carries the world’s largest deficit by either GDP share or dollar amount.

As Western politics has lately lost the appetite to roll back fiscal stimulus and political forces drift away from the centre toward unconventional policies, radical tools like debt cancellation have entered the political agenda. Even if never implemented, these low‑probability, high‑impact tail events have already reshaped market risk distribution.
Traditional debt‑reduction options are becoming increasingly difficult

White believes governments can lower debt through fiscal consolidation, growth or inflation, financial repression, selling state assets, default or restructuring, and debt cancellation or other forms of monetary financing.

However, fiscal consolidation may be costly in elections; growth is hampered by huge deficits; inflation is stoked by rising interest outlays; financial repression may arrive too late; and selling assets such as gold is a one‑off measure with limited effect. By contrast, outright debt cancellation is relatively easy to execute and may become more attractive to policymakers.
“Phantom debt erasure” could ignite inflation

Using the United States as an example, the Treasury could write down the Fed’s holdings of sovereign bonds—cutting them by, say, 10% or even canceling them outright—and then the Fed would record a negative equity position. Other variants include minting a platinum coin or opening unlimited central‑bank overdraft lines, but the essence is the same.

White pointed out that the reserves the Fed created through quantitative easing (QE) should be gradually retired as the Treasury repays maturing debt. If debt is cancelled directly, those reserves lose a redemption point, effectively creating a permanent monetary injection.

Whether through QE that accompanies fiscal expansion, yield‑curve control, or near‑limitless central‑bank financing of the Treasury, the end result can be higher inflation. As long as countries keep postponing painful but effective fiscal reforms and turn to stop‑gap measures like debt cancellation, the tail‑risk of the global debt cycle entering a “phantom debt erasure” phase will keep rising.

items.title: 金管會普渡 彭金隆許下三安之願 銀行局回應公民併
items.title_en: Financial Supervisory Commission Holds Mid‑Autumn Ritual, Chairman Peng Promises Safety, Security, Peace
paras: 金管會今(27)日舉行中元普渡祭祀，主委彭金隆親自率領各局官員祭拜，並公開許下「平安、安全、安心」的「三安之願」，期許金融市場在安全穩健的前提下發展，並打造讓民眾放心的金融環境。此外，近日市場掀起「公民併」話題，彰化銀行遴選財顧，外界解讀是為規劃併購國票金控做好準備，銀行局長童政彰回應，目前尚未收到任何個案申請，強調主管機關對所有股東、個案一視同仁，一切依循公開資訊與法規辦理。
彭金隆接受媒體聯訪時表示，今年的三個願望非常傳統，第一個「安」是祝願金管會全體同仁與媒體記者身體平安健康；第二個「安」則是安全，希望在安全穩定的前提下推動金融市場發展，支持產業繁榮與台灣經濟。
針對金融市場發展，彭金隆指出，未來將推動五大重點工作，包括推動「亞洲資產管理中心」國家計畫、建構國際級資本市場、完善虛擬資產服務市場制度、順應環境變化持續調整法規、持續鼓勵金融創新。
第三個「安」則是安心，希望打造讓全國民眾安心的金融交易環境。彭金隆提出四大努力方向，分別為強化金融消費者保護、提升公司治理、積極進行金融防詐、持續推動永續金融。
彭金隆強調，期望金融業能落實「信任金融」等宗旨，提供讓民眾放心交易的服務環境。

彰銀傳併國票金？銀行局長童政彰：目前無個案、法規一視同仁

針對彰銀日前於官網公告公開遴選財務顧問，引發市場揣測是否為併購國票金(公民併)做準備。童政彰表示，金管會的核心職責是建構公平、合理、開放的法治環境，金融機構依自身策略規劃進行茁壯發展，但目前「並沒有收到相關個案」。若後續有任何具體進度，金融機構皆會透過公開資訊揭露方式讓外界知曉。
針對媒體詢問是否有業者私下前來溝通，童政彰說明，業者與主管機關溝通屬於日常常態，但基於金融市場公開資訊揭露與敏感性原則，主管機關不會對外透露溝通細節。
至於「公公併」或「公民併」的政策考量，童政彰強調，不論大股東背景為何，主管機關皆一視同仁，一切回歸金融機構自身的發展策略與市場穩健運作。
paras_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) held a Mid‑Autumn ritual on the 27th, with Chairman Peng Jin‑long personally leading officials from various bureaus in worship and publicly pledging the "Three Safeties": peace, security, and reassurance, hoping the financial market will develop under a safe and stable foundation and create a trustworthy financial environment for the public. In addition, the market has recently discussed the "public merger" issue; Changhua Bank has selected a financial advisor, which outsiders interpret as preparation for a merger with National Ticket Financial Holding. Bank Bureau Director Tong Zheng‑zhang responded that no applications have been received, emphasizing that supervisory authorities treat all shareholders and cases equally, following public information and regulations.

Peng Jin‑long told reporters that this year’s three wishes are very traditional. The first "peace" wishes for the FSC staff and journalists to stay healthy; the second "peace" is security, hoping to promote financial market development on a secure and stable basis, supporting industrial prosperity and Taiwan’s economy.

Regarding financial market development, Peng Jin‑long outlined five key initiatives: advancing the "Asian Asset Management Center" national plan, building an international‑standard capital market, improving the virtual asset service market system, continuously adjusting regulations to match environmental changes, and encouraging financial innovation.

The third "peace" is reassurance, aiming to create a financial trading environment that gives the entire nation confidence. Peng Jin‑long proposed four major efforts: strengthening consumer protection, improving corporate governance, actively combating financial fraud, and promoting sustainable finance.
Peng Jin‑long emphasized the goal of implementing the "trustworthy finance" principle, providing a service environment that lets the public trade with confidence.

Changhua Bank’s announcement of a financial advisor sparked speculation that it may be preparing for a merger with National Ticket Financial (public merger). Bank Bureau Director Tong Zheng‑zhang stated that the FSC’s core duty is to build a fair, reasonable, and open legal environment, allowing institutions to grow according to their own strategies. He added that no related cases have been received and that any future progress will be disclosed publicly.

When asked by the media whether any firms had approached the bureau privately, Tong Zheng‑zhang explained that such communication is routine, but due to the principles of public disclosure and sensitivity, the authorities will not reveal details of these discussions.

Regarding the policy considerations of "public merger" or "public citizen merger," Tong Zheng‑zhang stressed that regardless of a major shareholder’s background, the authorities treat all equally, and everything ultimately depends on the financial institution’s own development strategy and market stability.

items.title: 智譜AI確認開發神秘模型「Ox Alpha」 股價飆升約10%
items.title_en: Zhitu AI Confirms Development of Mysterious Model "Ox Alpha", Shares Surge ~10%
paras: 中國人工智慧公司智譜AI(02513-HK)周四(27日)證實，先前在網路爆紅的神秘AI模型「Ox Alpha」(中文社區稱為「牛來」)正是由其自主研發。此消息提振了市場對中國AI企業競爭力的信心，促使其港股股價一度大漲9.7%至1,130港元，之後漲幅維持9%以上，收盤上漲12.6%。
「Ox Alpha」於8月20日匿名上架AI平台OpenRouter，隨即奪下平台歷史上最大規模發布的使用量排行榜首，Stripe執行長Patrick Collison更盛讚其表現「令人印象深刻」。智譜AI表示，模型的官方正式名稱為 GLM-5.3-Flash，代號靈感源自中國熱門電影《牛來》。
GLM-5.3-Flash是專為程式編碼和智慧代理任務設計的推理模型，支援文字、圖像及影片多模態輸入，具備100萬token的上下文視窗，且測試階段完全在中國製造的AI晶片上運行。
智譜AI計畫公開其模型權重，鼓勵開發者進行二次開發。其定價為每百萬輸入0.15美元、輸出0.50美元，與DeepSeek同屬低成本、高效率模型，直接挑戰Anthropic等美國付費服務。
這種「匿名發布」策略效法了阿里與小米，能為新服務提供更大的實驗自由。智譜AI將於下周一發布其上市後的首份半年業績報告。
paras_en: Zhitu AI (02513-HK) confirmed on Thursday (27th) that the mysterious AI model "Ox Alpha" (known in Chinese communities as "Niu Lai") was indeed developed in-house, boosting market confidence in Chinese AI firms and driving its Hong Kong shares up 9.7% to HK$1,130 before maintaining gains above 9% and closing up 12.6%.

"Ox Alpha" was anonymously launched on the AI platform OpenRouter on August 20, immediately topping the platform's all‑time highest usage leaderboard; Stripe CEO Patrick Collison praised its performance as "impressive." Zhitu AI stated the model's official name is GLM‑5.3‑Flash, with a codename inspired by the popular Chinese film "Niu Lai."

GLM‑5.3‑Flash is a reasoning model specifically designed for programming and intelligent agent tasks, supporting text, image, and video multimodal inputs, featuring a one‑million‑token context window, and was tested entirely on AI chips manufactured in China.

Zhitu AI plans to release its model weights publicly to encourage developers to build on it. Its pricing is $0.15 per million input tokens and $0.50 per million output tokens, positioning it as a low‑cost, high‑efficiency model that directly challenges U.S. paid services such as Anthropic.

This "anonymous release" strategy follows Alibaba and Xiaomi, allowing greater experimental freedom for new services. Zhitu AI will publish its first post‑listing half‑year earnings report next Monday.

items.title: 輝達拋驚人長期財測！科技巨頭營收排名大洗牌 將超車蘋果Alphabet躍居第二
items.title_en: NVIDIA Unveils Stunning Long‑Term Forecast, Tech Giant Revenue Rankings Shift, Set to Overtake Apple and Alphabet
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)周三(26日)盤後公布大幅優於市場預期的財報，最新一季營收較去年同期翻倍，然而直到財務長在財報電話會議上拋出一項驚人預測，市場才更加震撼：明年營收將強勁成長。
輝達Colette Kress告訴投資人，輝達2028會計年度營收成長率將達70%，遠高於LSEG調查分析師平均預估的44%。
輝達目前處在2027會計年度(明年1月為止)，市場預估營收將達3960億美元，財務長的預測代表2028會計年度的營收將攀升到6730億美元。
CNBC報導，依華爾街預測，這將使輝達屆時的營收規模超越蘋果(AAPL-US)與Alphabet(GOOGL-US)，在美國科技公司中僅次於亞馬遜(AMZN-US)。不過，亞馬遜目前仍主要是一家零售商。
在人工智慧(AI)熱潮掀起前，輝達還只是相對小眾的晶片商，但隨著AI狂潮風起雲遠，輝達屢次締造驚人里程碑：輝達如今已成為全球市值最高的公司，且仍持續繳出歷史性的高速成長。
若不是受到供應限制影響，輝達的財測可能還會更高。輝達目前正面臨記憶體等零組件短缺問題，而隨著全球AI基礎建設大舉擴張，記憶體市場也陷入供應緊張。
輝達執行長黃仁勳在財報電話會議上表示：「我們的需求遠高於70%。供應量讓我們有信心實現70%的成長，而我們也將持續與供應鏈合作，進一步提高供應量。」
輝達過去並未發布如此長期的財測，不過黃仁勳過去幾年曾針對未來兩年的AI晶片銷售提供一些預估數據。
他在電話會議上告訴分析師，輝達之所以發布這項預測，是因為公司已能掌握明年對運算能力的需求。他表示，由於輝達晶片正推動大規模投資，因此希望與提供土地及電力的合作夥伴保持一致。
黃仁勳說：「每個人都投入大量資源，因此我們希望確保所有人掌握相同的資訊。」
輝達周三表示，隨著AI具備執行實際工作的能力，其技術需求正從超大規模、數十億美元的AI基礎建設投資，擴散至更廣泛的企業客戶。
投資人一直擔心，輝達的成長主要由少數大型科技公司、也就是所謂的「超大規模雲端業者」(hyperscalers)所推動。這些業者正大舉擴建資料中心，而這些資料中心最終很大一部分是為OpenAI等少數前沿AI實驗室提供運算能力。
黃仁勳周三表示，早期AI基礎建設擴張主要由「一家實驗室」推動，但情況已經改變，輝達如今的客戶基礎更加廣泛。
黃仁勳在財報聲明中說：「需求正在加速。去年此時，僅一家實驗室就帶動基礎建設擴張，如今，我們即將迎接AI實驗室與新創公司的黃金時代，多家前沿AI實驗室同步擴大規模，開放模型生態系蓬勃發展，實體AI也開始投入運作，在美國及全球各地都展現強勁動能。」
黃仁勳在財報電話會議上進一步透露，他看好有一類新客戶帶來更大的成長空間：ACIE，涵蓋區域型AI公司、Neocloud雲端業者、新創公司及企業。
他表示，輝達的技術對這群客戶具有吸引力，原因在於輝達不僅能提供晶片，還能提供資料中心的大量其他技術。他指出，這類客戶過去大多「不為人所見」。
輝達本月稍早宣布一項計畫，協助這類公司及前沿AI實驗室取得六家大型金融機構提供的融資。黃仁暈表示：「隨著時間推移，全球這部分的運算需求很可能會比我們目前在雲端看到的規模還要大。我們看到的需求，是所有這些因素共同推動的。」
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) announced on Wednesday (26th) after market close a financial report that far exceeded market expectations, with the latest quarter’s revenue doubling year‑on‑year. It was only when the CFO threw out a startling prediction during the earnings call that the market was truly shocked: revenue will grow strongly next year.
NVIDIA’s Colette Kress told investors that the company’s revenue growth rate for fiscal year 2028 will reach 70%, far above the 44% average forecast by LSEG survey analysts.
NVIDIA is currently in fiscal year 2027 (through next January), with market estimates of revenue at $396 billion. The CFO’s forecast represents fiscal year 2028 revenue rising to $673 billion.

CNBC reported that, according to Wall Street predictions, this will allow NVIDIA’s revenue size to surpass Apple (AAPL‑US) and Alphabet (GOOGL‑US), ranking only behind Amazon (AMZN‑US) among U.S. tech companies. However, Amazon remains primarily a retailer.

Before the AI boom, NVIDIA was still a relatively niche chipmaker, but as the AI frenzy escalated, NVIDIA repeatedly set remarkable milestones: it is now the world’s most valuable company and continues to deliver historic high‑speed growth.

If not for supply constraints, NVIDIA’s forecast could be even higher. The company is currently facing shortages of components such as memory, and as global AI infrastructure expands, the memory market is also experiencing supply tightness.

NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang said in the earnings call, "Our demand is far above 70%. The supply volume gives us confidence to achieve 70% growth, and we will continue to work with the supply chain to further increase supply."
NVIDIA has not previously issued such a long‑term forecast, but Huang has provided some estimates for AI chip sales over the next two years in recent years.

In the call, he told analysts that NVIDIA released this forecast because the company can now grasp next year’s demand for computing power. He said that because NVIDIA chips are driving large‑scale investment, the company hopes to align with partners that provide land and power.
Huang said, "Everyone is investing heavily, so we want to ensure everyone has the same information."

NVIDIA said on Wednesday that as AI gains the ability to perform real work, its technology demand is shifting from ultra‑large‑scale, multi‑billion‑dollar AI infrastructure investments to a broader range of enterprise customers.

Investors have long worried that NVIDIA’s growth is mainly driven by a few large tech companies, the so‑called "hyperscalers," which are massively expanding data centers, most of which ultimately provide computing power for a handful of cutting‑edge AI labs such as OpenAI.
Huang said on Wednesday that early AI infrastructure expansion was mainly driven by "one lab," but the situation has changed, and NVIDIA’s customer base is now broader.

In the earnings statement, Huang said, "Demand is accelerating. At this time last year, only one lab drove infrastructure expansion. Today, we are about to enter a golden age of AI labs and startups, multiple cutting‑edge AI labs are expanding simultaneously, the open‑model ecosystem is thriving, and physical AI is starting to operate, showing strong momentum in the U.S. and worldwide."

Huang further revealed in the earnings call that he is optimistic about a new type of customer that will bring even greater growth: ACIE, covering regional AI companies, Neocloud cloud providers, startups, and enterprises.

He said NVIDIA’s technology is attractive to these customers because NVIDIA can provide not only chips but also a wide range of other data‑center technologies. He noted that these customers were previously largely "invisible."

Earlier this month, NVIDIA announced a plan to help these companies and cutting‑edge AI labs obtain financing from six major financial institutions. Huang said, "Over time, the global computing demand in this segment is likely to be larger than what we currently see in the cloud. The demand we see is driven by all these factors together."

items.title: 溢價買下AI開發者天堂！輝達傳以129億美元收購Hugging Face 看好開源AI成下一成長引擎
items.title_en: Premium Paid for AI Developer's Paradise! Nvidia Said to Agree to $12.9 Billion Purchase of Hugging Face, Betting Open‑Source AI as the Next Growth Engine
paras: 《The Information》周三(26日)引述知情人士報導，輝達(NVDA-US)已同意以129億美元，收購開放原始碼人工智慧(AI)模型平台Hugging Face。若交易規模屬實，將成為輝達迄今最大規模收購案之一，也凸顯這家由黃仁勳領軍、身處AI熱潮核心的公司，仍押注AI技術需求將持續擴張。
《Business Insider》周三稍早則報導，雙方一直就收購案進行談判，Hugging Face的估值可能超過130億美元。

收購價遠高於公司營收

Hugging Face提供開放原始碼大型語言模型及資料集，屬於可以自由使用及修改的開源AI模型，這與強調控制權及私有性的封閉式AI形成對比。而目前Anthropic、OpenAI等開發封閉式模型的業者，都正尋求自行開發AI晶片，以降低對輝達GPU的依賴。
從報導披露的129億美元的收購價格來看，與Hugging Face每年約1.5億美元的營收形成巨大落差。根據《The Information》本周的稍早報導，Hugging Face年化營收約1.5億美元。
輝達曾與Salesforce(CRM-US)以及Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下Google等公司，在2023年共同參與Hugging Face某一輪2.35億美元的募資，當時對Hugging Face估值為45億美元。在那之後，輝達向整個AI生態系投入數十億美元，包括投資AI開發商OpenAI。
英國《金融時報》(FT)今年1月報導，Hugging Face去年拒絕輝達提出的5億美元投資案。若當時接受這項投資，Hugging Face的估值將達70億美元。

為何選中Hugging Face？

輝達押注AI需求強勁的策略，在周三公布財測時進一步獲得證實：該公司預估新一會計年度營收將成長70%，並表示截至2027年度，公司已承諾投入180億美元進行股權投資。
輝達執行長黃仁勳在周三財報電話會議上說：「全球將同時需要封閉式模型與開放模型(both closed models and open models )，而且這兩種模型的使用量都在快速飆升。」
他進一步補充，「幾乎所有開放式模型都在輝達的平台上運行」。
隨著開發者尋求更具成本效益的AI開發方式，開源AI正快速升溫，業者透過發布模型權重等內容，讓其他開發者能夠輕鬆在其成果上進一步開發。
Hugging Face將自己定位為AI開發者平台。該公司表示，平台讓AI開發者能輕鬆取得建立AI應用程式所需的各類工具，並與科技業其他開發者合作。
Hugging Face的使用者可以免費瀏覽、下載內容並進行其他活動，但Hugging Face也提供Pro訂閱服務，讓使用者「探索AI的完整領域，包括文字、圖像、影片、音訊、3D等」。訂閱服務也提供更高的運算能力，包括「最多40分鐘RTX Pro 6000 Blackwell」的運算資源，這是輝達的一款硬體產品。
這項收購報導發布前約一個月，Hugging Face才剛遭遇一起資安事件，當時由於OpenAI一款模型失控後觸發駭客攻擊，導致Hugging Face的基礎設施遭到入侵。
paras_en: The Information reported on Wednesday (the 26th) that Nvidia (NVDA-US) has agreed to acquire the open‑source AI model platform Hugging Face for $12.9 billion. If the deal size is accurate, it would be one of Nvidia’s largest acquisitions to date and underscores that the company, led by Jensen Huang and at the heart of the AI boom, still bets on a continued expansion of AI‑technology demand.
Business Insider reported earlier on Wednesday that the two sides have been negotiating the deal and that Hugging Face’s valuation could exceed $13 billion.

The acquisition price is far higher than the company’s revenue. Hugging Face provides open‑source large language models and datasets that can be freely used and modified, contrasting with closed‑AI systems that emphasize control and privacy. Companies such as Anthropic and OpenAI, which develop closed models, are currently seeking to build their own AI chips to reduce reliance on Nvidia GPUs.

At the disclosed price of $12.9 billion, the purchase price dwarfs Hugging Face’s roughly $150 million annual revenue. The Information earlier this week reported that Hugging Face’s annualized revenue is about $150 million.

Nvidia previously participated with Salesforce (CRM‑US) and Google, an Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) subsidiary, in a $235 million financing round for Hugging Face in 2023, which valued the company at $4.5 billion. Since then, Nvidia has poured tens of billions of dollars into the broader AI ecosystem, including investments in AI developer OpenAI.
The UK Financial Times reported in January that Hugging Face turned down a $500 million investment offer from Nvidia last year. Had the company accepted, its valuation would have risen to $7 billion.

Why choose Hugging Face? Nvidia’s strategy of betting on strong AI demand was further validated on Wednesday when it released its fiscal guidance, forecasting a 70% revenue growth for the next accounting year and pledging $18 billion in equity investments through 2027.
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said on the earnings call Wednesday, "The world will need both closed models and open models, and usage of both is accelerating rapidly."
He added, "Almost all open models run on Nvidia’s platform."

As developers look for more cost‑effective ways to build AI, open‑source AI is heating up quickly, with companies publishing model weights and other assets so that other developers can easily build on top of them.

Hugging Face positions itself as an AI developer platform. The company says the platform gives AI developers easy access to the variety of tools needed to build AI applications and to collaborate with other technologists.

Users can browse and download content for free and perform other activities, but Hugging Face also offers a Pro subscription that lets users "explore the full AI stack, including text, images, video, audio, 3D, and more." The subscription also provides higher compute power, including access to "up to 40‑minute RTX Pro 6000 Blackwell" resources, a hardware product from Nvidia.
The acquisition story was published about a month after Hugging Face suffered a security incident when a runaway OpenAI model triggered a hack that compromised the company’s infrastructure.

items.title: AIDC吃電怎「選址」？龔明鑫釋解方：北部電網受限 中南部成設置首選
items.title_en: How Do AI Data Centers Choose Locations? Minister Gong Ming‑Xin Explains: Northern Grid Constraints Make Central‑South Regions the Top Choice
paras: 經濟部長龔明鑫今（27）日主持經濟部業務會報前受訪，針對AI資料中心（Data Center，AIDC）選址原則及電電工會推動海外科學園區招商等熱門產業議題，針對用電大戶AIDC的選址方向，他並首度指出，經濟部續將推出更明確且詳盡的選址引導規範，以協助 AIDC 順利「落地」。
在AI資料中心選址規劃方面，龔明鑫強調，台電先前已明確指出，新竹以北地區受限於電網瓶頸，若要設置大型AI資料中心需經過特別審查，中南部地區則無此「限管」問題，供電能力較能支應大容量需求。經濟部目前正與有意願設立資料中心的相關企業進行座談與溝通，瞭解產業實際需求與營運考量，後續將出台更明確且詳盡的選址引導規範，協助企業在電網韌性與區域資源間取得最佳平衡，確保AI關鍵基礎設施順利落腳。
此外，談及電電工會積極推動墨西哥海外科學園區選址一事，龔明鑫證實，墨西哥選址方向已基本確定，並已由工會主辦說明會向外界說明。
龔明鑫表示，經濟部除了派員參與相關活動外，若企業在赴海外設廠招商或與當地政府協商過程中需要官方協助，經濟部將全力配合並提供必要的跨國對接支援，包括與對方政府建構良好聯繫管道等。若後續有再次招商需求，經濟部亦會配合一同舉辦，協助台灣電子零組件及資通訊產業完善全球供應鏈布局，深化台美與北美區域經濟夥伴關係。
paras_en: Minister of Economic Affairs Gong Ming‑Xin was interviewed before chairing the ministry’s business meeting on the 27th, discussing site‑selection principles for AI data centers (AIDC) and the overseas science‑park investment push by the Electrical Workers Union. He said the ministry will soon issue clearer, more detailed location‑guidance rules to help AIDCs settle smoothly.

Regarding AIDC site planning, Gong emphasized that Taipower has already indicated that areas north of Hsinchu face grid bottlenecks and would require special review for large AI data centers, whereas the central‑southern region has no such restrictions and can better meet high‑capacity power needs. The ministry is currently holding talks with interested companies to understand their actual needs and operational considerations, and will later issue more precise site‑selection guidelines to balance grid resilience with regional resources, ensuring AI‑critical infrastructure can be established successfully.

He also addressed the Electrical Workers Union’s active promotion of a site in a Mexican overseas science park, confirming that the location direction in Mexico is essentially settled and that the union has already held briefings to inform the public.

Gong added that, besides sending staff to related events, the ministry will fully support companies that need official assistance when investing abroad or negotiating with local governments, providing cross‑border liaison support and helping build good communication channels with foreign authorities. If further investment promotion is needed, the ministry will co‑organize it to help Taiwan’s electronic components and ICT industries完善全球供應鏈布局, deepening Taiwan‑U.S. and North‑American regional economic partnerships.

items.title: 南俊國際通用伺服器缺料緩解 Q2將是今年最低點 VR、ASIC滑軌Q3放量
items.title_en: Nan Jun International General Server Material Shortage Eases, Q2 Will Be Year’s Low Point, VR and ASIC Slides Ramp Up in Q3
paras: 伺服器滑軌廠南俊國際(6584-TW)今(27)日參加櫃買業績發表會，總經理特助暨代理發言人任忠仁表示，受惠於通用型伺服器供應鏈缺料問題逐步緩解，加上輝達Vera Rubin系列滑軌與美系CSP客戶的ASIC滑軌於第3季正式啟動量產，第2季營運已確立為全年谷底，後續將重回逐季成長軌道。
任忠仁提到，先前輝達GB系列因新產品導入與認證進度落後同業，以及通用伺服器因零組件缺料，導致第2季出貨與市占受限，但次世代Vera Rubin系列滑軌開發時程已全面跟上，預計於8月啟動少量出貨並在9月放量交付一線雲端大廠，隨著高階AI伺服器滑軌出貨比重拉升，將進一步帶動平均銷售單價與毛利率向上成長。
產能分配部分，任忠仁指出，目前越南租賃廠兩條Eagle Stream產線維持滿載，Birch Stream產線持續進行自動化改善，預計第4季將再導入4U儲存機櫃與隱藏式滑軌專用線；自建的越南新廠正進行建照申請，預計於明年底完工，屆時整體產線規模將可擴充至20條。
任忠仁提到，受惠於大客戶落實非台灣與非中國產能政策，越南廠第2季占合併營收比重已達20%，第3季有望突破30%，憑藉當地材料成本比台灣便宜2-3成及匯率優勢，有效支撐毛利率表現。
面對同業競爭，任忠仁表示，南俊建立極為嚴謹的智財管理機制，由專職工程師每月份成三組定期監控同業專利動態，若遇相似設計均先委託外部專利事務所進行鑑定以確保避開侵權風險。為大幅加速新產品導入時程，目前在VR世代與同業的進度差距已顯著縮小至一季以內。
任忠仁指出，GB300滑軌報價區間約為60至70美元，新一代VR滑軌報價則落在70至80美元。相較於過去在GB系列開發速度落後同業，公司在VR世代已建立30多種截面規格與豐富專利庫，大幅縮短客製化開發時程三至六個月，並在雲科三廠建立專線以加速量產節奏。
產品占比部分，南俊國際今年上半年每股純益近6.5元。上半年伺服器產品占整體營收比重達70%，其中純GB系列占營收約5%，若加計交換器與其他AI相關產品在內的泛AI比重則落在15%至20%之間。
paras_en: Nan Jun International (6584‑TW) attended today’s (27th) OTC earnings briefing. Assistant General Manager and acting spokesperson Ren Zhong‑ren said the company is benefiting from the gradual easing of material shortages in the generic server supply chain, and with Nvidia’s Vera Rubin series slides and U.S. CSP customers’ ASIC slides entering mass production in Q3, Q2 operations have been confirmed as the annual trough, after which the company will return to a quarter‑by‑quarter growth trajectory.

Ren noted that Nvidia’s GB series had previously lagged peers in new product introduction and certification, and generic servers faced component shortages, limiting Q2 shipments and market share. However, the development schedule for the next‑generation Vera Rubin slides is now fully on track, with a small‑volume launch expected in August and volume deliveries to major cloud providers slated for September. As the share of high‑end AI server slides rises, average selling price and gross margin are expected to improve further.

Regarding capacity allocation, Ren said the two Eagle Stream production lines at the leased Vietnam plant are running at full capacity, while the Birch Stream line is undergoing automation upgrades. A dedicated line for 4U storage cabinets and hidden slides is planned for Q4. The company’s own new Vietnam facility is currently applying for a construction permit and is expected to be completed by the end of next year, at which point total production capacity could expand to 20 lines.

Ren added that, thanks to major customers implementing non‑Taiwan and non‑China capacity policies, the Vietnam plant already accounted for 20% of consolidated revenue in Q2 and is expected to exceed 30% in Q3. Lower local material costs—20‑30% cheaper than in Taiwan—and favorable exchange rates are helping sustain gross‑margin performance.

Facing industry competition, Ren said Nan Jun has established a rigorous intellectual‑property management system, with three teams of dedicated engineers monitoring competitors’ patents monthly. When similar designs are identified, external patent firms are engaged for clearance to avoid infringement risk. To accelerate new‑product introductions, the gap with peers in the VR generation has been narrowed to less than one quarter.

Ren indicated that the GB300 slide is priced between US$60 and US$70, while the new‑generation VR slide ranges from US$70 to US$80. Compared with the slower GB‑series development in the past, the VR generation now boasts over 30 cross‑section specifications and a rich patent portfolio, cutting custom development time by three to six months, and a dedicated line at CloudTech Plant 3 has been set up to speed up mass production.

In terms of product mix, Nan Jun International reported earnings per share of nearly NT$6.5 for the first half of the year. Server products accounted for 70% of total revenue in H1, with the pure GB series contributing about 5% of revenue. Including switches and other AI‑related products, the broader AI segment represents 15%‑20% of revenue.

items.title: 〈景氣燈號〉連亮8紅！41分持平、製造業回溫 經濟動能穩健但要留意4大不確定
items.title_en: Economic Indicator Lights Show 8 Consecutive Reds! Index Holds at 41, Manufacturing Warmed Up – Growth Momentum Steady but Watch Four Major Uncertainties
paras: 國發會今（27）日公布116年7月景氣對策信號，綜合判斷分數為41分，與上周持平，燈號續亮紅燈，呈現連續第8個紅燈。其中，製造業營業氣候測驗點受惠AI需求持續強勁，由綠燈轉呈黃紅燈；貨幣總計數M1B受外資淨匯出影響，由黃紅燈轉為綠燈；另領先及同時指標持續上升，顯示國內經濟成長動能相當穩健；但仍需留意中東情勢發展、美國關稅政策變化、主要國家貨幣政策動向及財政不確定性等因素影響。
9項構成項目中，製造業營業氣候測驗點由上月98.61點增至101.09點，增加1分，燈號由綠燈轉呈黃紅燈；貨幣總計數M1B變動率由9.4%降至7.3%，減少1分，燈號由黃紅燈轉為綠燈。其餘7項燈號維持不變，包括股價指數、工業生產指數、海關出口值、機械及電機設備進口值、製造業銷售量指數、批發零售及餐飲業營業額等6項續呈紅燈，工業及服務業加班工時變動率則續呈黃紅燈。
指標方面，7月領先指標不含趨勢指數為104.63，周增0.72%，7個構成項目中有5項上升，包括外銷訂單動向指數、股價指數、實質半導體設備進口值、製造業營業氣候測驗點及實質貨幣總計數M1B；同時指標不含趨勢指數為106.80，周增0.36%，批發零售及餐飲業營業額、工業生產指數、製造業銷售量指數與電力總用電量等4項均呈現上升。
展望未來，國發會指出，隨著AI應用深化推升算力需求，全球主要雲端服務商加速AI基礎建設，加上消費性電子新品進入備貨階段，出口可望延續成長態勢。投資方面，國內半導體及AI供應鏈積極擴產，國際大廠亦擴大在台投資與採購，加上政府推動中小微及傳統產業轉型升級，均有助民間投資擴增。
消費方面，上市櫃企業獲利良好，增添加薪及股利發放意願，加以就業市場穩健、車市買氣回溫，皆可望活絡消費。惟國際經貿仍受中東情勢發展、美國關稅政策變化、主要國家貨幣政策動向及財政不確定性等因素影響，仍須密切留意後續發展。
paras_en: The National Development Council released the July 2023 economic policy signal today (27th), with a composite score of 41 points, unchanged from last week. The signal light remains red for the eighth consecutive time. Among the components, the manufacturing business climate index, boosted by strong AI demand, shifted from green to a yellow‑red light; the total money supply M1B, affected by net foreign‑exchange outflows, moved from a yellow‑red light to green. Leading and coincident indicators continue to rise, indicating that domestic growth momentum remains robust, though attention is needed for developments in the Middle East, changes in U.S. tariff policy, major countries’ monetary policy directions, and fiscal uncertainties.

Of the nine constituent items, the manufacturing business climate index rose from 98.61 last month to 101.09, a one‑point increase, changing its light from green to yellow‑red. The M1B growth rate fell from 9.4% to 7.3%, a one‑point drop, turning its light from yellow‑red to green. The other seven lights stayed the same: the stock‑price index, industrial production index, customs export value, imports of machinery and electrical equipment, manufacturing sales index, and wholesale‑retail‑restaurant sales all remain red, while the change rate of overtime hours in industry and services stays yellow‑red.

On the indicator side, the July leading index excluding the trend component was 104.63, up 0.72% week‑over‑week, with five of its seven components rising – the export orders index, stock‑price index, real semiconductor equipment imports, manufacturing business climate index, and real M1B. The coincident index excluding the trend component was 106.80, up 0.36% week‑over‑week, with four components – wholesale‑retail‑restaurant sales, industrial production index, manufacturing sales index and total electricity consumption – all increasing.

Looking ahead, the council noted that deeper AI applications are driving higher computing‑power demand, prompting major global cloud providers to accelerate AI infrastructure build‑out. Combined with consumer‑electronics new‑product stock‑building, exports are expected to keep growing. On the investment side, domestic semiconductor and AI supply chains are expanding capacity, foreign giants are increasing investment and procurement in Taiwan, and government‑led upgrades of SMEs and traditional industries should further boost private investment.

On the consumption side, listed companies are posting solid profits, increasing willingness to raise wages and pay dividends. Coupled with a sturdy labor market and a warming auto market, consumer activity is likely to pick up. Nevertheless, international trade remains vulnerable to Middle‑East developments, U.S. tariff policy shifts, major economies’ monetary policy moves and fiscal uncertainties, which require close monitoring.

items.title: 金管會普渡 彭金隆許下三安之願 銀行局回應公民併
items.title_en: Financial Supervisory Commission Holds Mid‑Autumn Ritual, Chairman Peng Promises Safety, Security, Peace
paras: 金管會今(27)日舉行中元普渡祭祀，主委彭金隆親自率領各局官員祭拜，並公開許下「平安、安全、安心」的「三安之願」，期許金融市場在安全穩健的前提下發展，並打造讓民眾放心的金融環境。此外，近日市場掀起「公民併」話題，彰化銀行遴選財顧，外界解讀是為規劃併購國票金控做好準備，銀行局長童政彰回應，目前尚未收到任何個案申請，強調主管機關對所有股東、個案一視同仁，一切依循公開資訊與法規辦理。
彭金隆接受媒體聯訪時表示，今年的三個願望非常傳統，第一個「安」是祝願金管會全體同仁與媒體記者身體平安健康；第二個「安」則是安全，希望在安全穩定的前提下推動金融市場發展，支持產業繁榮與台灣經濟。
針對金融市場發展，彭金隆指出，未來將推動五大重點工作，包括推動「亞洲資產管理中心」國家計畫、建構國際級資本市場、完善虛擬資產服務市場制度、順應環境變化持續調整法規、持續鼓勵金融創新。
第三個「安」則是安心，希望打造讓全國民眾安心的金融交易環境。彭金隆提出四大努力方向，分別為強化金融消費者保護、提升公司治理、積極進行金融防詐、持續推動永續金融。
彭金隆強調，期望金融業能落實「信任金融」等宗旨，提供讓民眾放心交易的服務環境。

彰銀傳併國票金？銀行局長童政彰：目前無個案、法規一視同仁

針對彰銀日前於官網公告公開遴選財務顧問，引發市場揣測是否為併購國票金(公民併)做準備。童政彰表示，金管會的核心職責是建構公平、合理、開放的法治環境，金融機構依自身策略規劃進行茁壯發展，但目前「並沒有收到相關個案」。若後續有任何具體進度，金融機構皆會透過公開資訊揭露方式讓外界知曉。
針對媒體詢問是否有業者私下前來溝通，童政彰說明，業者與主管機關溝通屬於日常常態，但基於金融市場公開資訊揭露與敏感性原則，主管機關不會對外透露溝通細節。
至於「公公併」或「公民併」的政策考量，童政彰強調，不論大股東背景為何，主管機關皆一視同仁，一切回歸金融機構自身的發展策略與市場穩健運作。
paras_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) held a Mid‑Autumn ritual on the 27th, with Chairman Peng Jin‑long personally leading officials from various bureaus in worship and publicly pledging the "Three Safeties": peace, security, and reassurance, hoping the financial market will develop under a safe and stable foundation and create a trustworthy financial environment for the public. In addition, the market has recently discussed the "public merger" issue; Changhua Bank has selected a financial advisor, which outsiders interpret as preparation for a merger with National Ticket Financial Holding. Bank Bureau Director Tong Zheng‑zhang responded that no applications have been received, emphasizing that supervisory authorities treat all shareholders and cases equally, following public information and regulations.

Peng Jin‑long told reporters that this year’s three wishes are very traditional. The first "peace" wishes for the FSC staff and journalists to stay healthy; the second "peace" is security, hoping to promote financial market development on a secure and stable basis, supporting industrial prosperity and Taiwan’s economy.

Regarding financial market development, Peng Jin‑long outlined five key initiatives: advancing the "Asian Asset Management Center" national plan, building an international‑standard capital market, improving the virtual asset service market system, continuously adjusting regulations to match environmental changes, and encouraging financial innovation.

The third "peace" is reassurance, aiming to create a financial trading environment that gives the entire nation confidence. Peng Jin‑long proposed four major efforts: strengthening consumer protection, improving corporate governance, actively combating financial fraud, and promoting sustainable finance.
Peng Jin‑long emphasized the goal of implementing the "trustworthy finance" principle, providing a service environment that lets the public trade with confidence.

Changhua Bank’s announcement of a financial advisor sparked speculation that it may be preparing for a merger with National Ticket Financial (public merger). Bank Bureau Director Tong Zheng‑zhang stated that the FSC’s core duty is to build a fair, reasonable, and open legal environment, allowing institutions to grow according to their own strategies. He added that no related cases have been received and that any future progress will be disclosed publicly.

When asked by the media whether any firms had approached the bureau privately, Tong Zheng‑zhang explained that such communication is routine, but due to the principles of public disclosure and sensitivity, the authorities will not reveal details of these discussions.

Regarding the policy considerations of "public merger" or "public citizen merger," Tong Zheng‑zhang stressed that regardless of a major shareholder’s background, the authorities treat all equally, and everything ultimately depends on the financial institution’s own development strategy and market stability.

items.title: AIDC吃電怎「選址」？龔明鑫釋解方：北部電網受限 中南部成設置首選
items.title_en: How Do AI Data Centers Choose Locations? Minister Gong Ming‑Xin Explains: Northern Grid Constraints Make Central‑South Regions the Top Choice
paras: 經濟部長龔明鑫今（27）日主持經濟部業務會報前受訪，針對AI資料中心（Data Center，AIDC）選址原則及電電工會推動海外科學園區招商等熱門產業議題，針對用電大戶AIDC的選址方向，他並首度指出，經濟部續將推出更明確且詳盡的選址引導規範，以協助 AIDC 順利「落地」。
在AI資料中心選址規劃方面，龔明鑫強調，台電先前已明確指出，新竹以北地區受限於電網瓶頸，若要設置大型AI資料中心需經過特別審查，中南部地區則無此「限管」問題，供電能力較能支應大容量需求。經濟部目前正與有意願設立資料中心的相關企業進行座談與溝通，瞭解產業實際需求與營運考量，後續將出台更明確且詳盡的選址引導規範，協助企業在電網韌性與區域資源間取得最佳平衡，確保AI關鍵基礎設施順利落腳。
此外，談及電電工會積極推動墨西哥海外科學園區選址一事，龔明鑫證實，墨西哥選址方向已基本確定，並已由工會主辦說明會向外界說明。
龔明鑫表示，經濟部除了派員參與相關活動外，若企業在赴海外設廠招商或與當地政府協商過程中需要官方協助，經濟部將全力配合並提供必要的跨國對接支援，包括與對方政府建構良好聯繫管道等。若後續有再次招商需求，經濟部亦會配合一同舉辦，協助台灣電子零組件及資通訊產業完善全球供應鏈布局，深化台美與北美區域經濟夥伴關係。
paras_en: Minister of Economic Affairs Gong Ming‑Xin was interviewed before chairing the ministry’s business meeting on the 27th, discussing site‑selection principles for AI data centers (AIDC) and the overseas science‑park investment push by the Electrical Workers Union. He said the ministry will soon issue clearer, more detailed location‑guidance rules to help AIDCs settle smoothly.

Regarding AIDC site planning, Gong emphasized that Taipower has already indicated that areas north of Hsinchu face grid bottlenecks and would require special review for large AI data centers, whereas the central‑southern region has no such restrictions and can better meet high‑capacity power needs. The ministry is currently holding talks with interested companies to understand their actual needs and operational considerations, and will later issue more precise site‑selection guidelines to balance grid resilience with regional resources, ensuring AI‑critical infrastructure can be established successfully.

He also addressed the Electrical Workers Union’s active promotion of a site in a Mexican overseas science park, confirming that the location direction in Mexico is essentially settled and that the union has already held briefings to inform the public.

Gong added that, besides sending staff to related events, the ministry will fully support companies that need official assistance when investing abroad or negotiating with local governments, providing cross‑border liaison support and helping build good communication channels with foreign authorities. If further investment promotion is needed, the ministry will co‑organize it to help Taiwan’s electronic components and ICT industries完善全球供應鏈布局, deepening Taiwan‑U.S. and North‑American regional economic partnerships.

items.title: 台新新光金認真落實普惠金融 獲台灣永續行動獎5項大獎
items.title_en: Taishin Shin Kong Financial Group Earns Five Awards at Taiwan Sustainable Action Awards
paras: 由台灣永續能源研究基金會所主辦的「2026年台灣永續行動獎」於27日舉行頒獎典禮，台新新光金控(2887-TW)旗下子公司共囊獲5座大獎，台新銀行、新光銀行及台新投信榮獲社會共融類「金獎」肯定、新光人壽及台新證券分別榮獲環境永續類及社會共融類別「銅獎」榮譽。此外，台新新光金控連續五年參與臺灣規模最大的永續會展「亞太永續博覽會」，以實際行動展現集團共同投入永續行動的決心。

台新銀行及新光銀行分別以「高齡安心、失智友善」行動及「同理心的力量-金融平權計畫」，榮獲社會共融類-金獎。台新銀行從打造服務文化、守護資產安全到提升金融服務便利性持續推進，已達成101家分行加入失智友善組織、近2,000位行員成為失智友善天使，並攜手亞東醫院培訓第一線失智友善服務專員，強化對高齡與失智客戶的支持與守護。新光銀行則透過營業廳無障礙空間優化、教育訓練課程建立內部同理文化，並為加強不同族群資訊易讀性與公平待客推動，設計六心級溝通手冊、銀行易讀手冊、防詐桌遊、舉辦防詐講座，跨越金融理解與使用的障礙。
新光人壽憑藉「氣候自然雙軌永續行動」獲得環境永續類-銅獎。新光人壽展現金融業引導產業轉型的關鍵影響力，面對極端氣候與生態退化之雙重危機，全面導入TCFD情境分析及TNFD之LEAP評估法，將「氣候減碳」與「自然共生」化為可複製的金融經營模式，樹立兼顧環境韌性、社會共融與經濟發展的標竿典範。
台新證券及台新投信分別藉「數位無界共創金融平權」及「移工基金理財課程」，分別榮獲社會共融類-銅獎及金獎。台新證券整合多元媒體、數位內容與專題文章，依據不同投資階段，提供淺顯易懂的金融知識，有效降低學習門檻並消弭資訊落差，具體實踐以數位創新落實普惠金融。台新投信以基金管理投資專業與長期關注東南亞移工教育的One-Forty基金會攜手合作，共同辦理基金理財課程，協助移工建構理財能力。
台新新光金控永續長李鎮宇指出，此次各子公司在永續行動獎的表現卓越，未來也會持續助力金控在國際永續評比持續領航。為響應永續行動，台新新光金控已連續五年參與臺灣規模最大的永續會展「亞太永續博覽會」展覽，自8月27至29日於世貿中心展覽一館展出。展期中將舉辦共13場的系列講座，議題涵蓋ESG各面向，包含永續發展趨勢、AI與ESG的雙軸轉型、普惠金融，到永續投資誠摯邀請民眾前往參與，掌握永續發展脈動。

近年來，台新新光金控永續發展成果非凡，台新新光金控的永續成就包括獲得「標普全球」(S&P Global)「2026年標普全球永續年鑑」(The Sustainability Yearbook 2026)銀行產業別全球Top 1%三連霸，是全球首家銀行產業別(Bank Industry) 獲此卓越成就的金融機構，並連續8年入選道瓊領先指數(DJBIC)世界及新興市場指數雙榜；此外2026年也持續獲得MSCI ESG評級之AAA最高評級肯定。未來，台新新光將持續依循國際永續脈動、恪遵金管會政策指引，並以「From Zero to Hero」的精神善盡金融業資金引導角色，共同攜手實踐淨零轉型，成為各產業邁向永續的智慧好夥伴。
paras_en: The "2026 Taiwan Sustainable Action Awards" organized by the Taiwan Sustainable Energy Research Foundation held its ceremony on the 27th, where subsidiaries of Taishin Shin Kong Financial Holding (2887‑TW) captured five top honors. Taishin Bank, Shin Kong Bank and Taishin Asset Management received the Gold Award in the Social Inclusion category, while Shin Kong Life and Taishin Securities each earned a Bronze Award in the Environmental Sustainability and Social Inclusion categories respectively. In addition, Taishin Shin Kong Financial Holding has participated for five consecutive years in Taiwan’s largest sustainability expo, the Asia‑Pacific Sustainable Expo, demonstrating the group’s commitment to joint sustainability actions.

Taishin Bank and Shin Kong Bank each won the Gold Award in the Social Inclusion category with their initiatives “Aging‑Friendly, Dementia‑Friendly” and “The Power of Empathy – Financial Inclusion Project.” Taishin Bank has advanced service culture, asset safety and financial convenience, achieving 101 branches joining dementia‑friendly networks, nearly 2,000 staff becoming dementia‑friendly ambassadors, and partnering with Far Eastern Memorial Hospital to train frontline dementia‑friendly service specialists, strengthening support for elderly and dementia customers. Shin Kong Bank enhanced barrier‑free spaces in its branches, built an internal empathy culture through training, and promoted information accessibility and fair treatment for diverse groups by creating a six‑level communication handbook, a bank readability guide, anti‑fraud board games, and hosting anti‑fraud seminars, breaking down financial understanding and usage barriers.

Shin Kong Life earned the Bronze Award in the Environmental Sustainability category for its “Climate‑Nature Dual‑Track Sustainable Action.” The insurer showcased the financial sector’s pivotal role in guiding industry transformation, confronting both extreme climate events and ecological degradation by fully adopting TCFD scenario analysis and TNFD’s LEAP assessment, turning “climate mitigation” and “nature co‑existence” into replicable financial operating models, setting a benchmark that balances environmental resilience, social inclusion and economic development.

Taishin Securities and Taishin Asset Management won the Bronze Award in Social Inclusion and the Gold Award respectively, with “Digital Borderless Co‑Creation for Financial Inclusion” and a “Migrant Worker Fund Financial Literacy Course.” Taishin Securities integrated diverse media, digital content and feature articles to provide easy‑to‑understand financial knowledge tailored to different investment stages, lowering learning barriers and closing information gaps, thereby realizing inclusive finance through digital innovation. Taishin Asset Management partnered with the One‑Forty Foundation, which focuses on Southeast Asian migrant worker education, to offer fund‑management‑based financial literacy courses that help migrant workers build financial capability.

Taishin Shin Kong Financial Holding’s sustainability chief, Lee Chen‑Yu, highlighted the outstanding performance of its subsidiaries in the awards and pledged continued support for the holding company’s leadership in international sustainability rankings. To further its sustainability agenda, the group has again participated in the Asia‑Pacific Sustainable Expo, Taiwan’s largest sustainability exhibition, at the World Trade Center Hall 1 from August 27‑29, featuring 13 seminars covering ESG topics such as sustainability trends, AI‑ESG dual transformation, inclusive finance and sustainable investing, inviting the public to engage and stay abreast of sustainability developments.

In recent years, Taishin Shin Kong Financial Holding has achieved remarkable sustainability milestones. It was named in S&P Global’s 2026 Sustainability Yearbook as the global top 1% bank industry performer for the third consecutive year—the first bank industry entity to earn this distinction—and has been included for eight straight years in the Dow Jones Sustainability Indices (both World and Emerging Markets). In 2026 it also retained MSCI’s highest AAA ESG rating. Looking ahead, the group will continue to follow international sustainability trends, adhere to Financial Supervisory Commission guidelines, and embody a “From Zero to Hero” spirit to guide capital toward net‑zero transformation, positioning itself as a smart partner for industries pursuing sustainability.

items.title: 搶攻AI與風電！龔明鑫預告上修長期電力需求：年增率將破2.5%
items.title_en: Racing to Capture AI and Offshore Wind! Minister Gong Ming‑xin Forecasts Revised Long‑Term Power Demand: Annual Growth Rate to Exceed 2.5%
paras: ​​​​​​​經濟部長龔明鑫今（27）日主持經濟部業務會報前受訪，針對全台長期電源規劃、離岸風機事故及台電與中油115年追加預算案等議題進行說明。因應AI產業帶來的爆發性成長，龔明鑫指出，電力需求年均複合成長率已由1.7%上修至2.5%，十年電源規劃採高推估，以確保供電無虞。

針對產業最關心的電力供應問題，龔明鑫表示，維持穩定供電是政府首要任務，長期電源規劃通常以10年為期進行滾動式預估。考量經濟成長、實際用電需求變化及節能措施等多重參數，規劃團隊會針對高、中、低情境進行推估。他指出，先前電力需求年均複合成長率已由1.7%上修至2.5%，因應未來AI產業快速發展，用電需求將進一步推升，經濟部將採較高的推估標準進行準備，預計上修後的年均成長率將高於2.5%，細節確定後會儘快對外公布。目前準備的電源供應能量，仍可充分支持高推估情境下的用電成長。
針對日前離岸風機發生的火災事故，龔明鑫說明，該起事故為台灣設置500多座離岸風機以來發生的首例事故。由於該風機仍處於「測試併網」階段，過程容許並容納部分技術調整需求，經初步調查，確認為單一機組的技術故障引發，並未影響其他風機運作，受損區域亦僅限於機組尾部與風葉，未擴大造成更大損害，經濟部已要求能源署持續釐清深入原因。
最後，針對台電與中油115年度追加預算盤點進度，龔明鑫指出，經濟部已與主計總處進行多次研商與數字回報，但整體推動節奏仍需尊重主計總處及其他相關部會的橫向協調。他說明，追加預算通常需待當年度預算案獲立法院審議通過後，若發現資金仍有不足才會依程序提出追加，若預算案能順利通過，後續追加預算推行節奏也會加快。
paras_en: Minister of Economic Affairs Gong Ming‑xin was interviewed before chairing today’s (27th) Economic Affairs Council meeting, where he explained Taiwan’s long‑term power planning, a recent offshore wind turbine accident, and the 2026 supplemental budget proposals for Taipower and CPC. In response to the explosive growth of the AI industry, Gong said the annual compound growth rate for electricity demand has been revised upward from 1.7% to 2.5%, and the ten‑year power plan adopts a high‑estimate scenario to ensure reliable supply.

Addressing the industry’s top concern—power supply—Gong said maintaining stable electricity is the government’s primary task, and long‑term power planning is done on a rolling ten‑year basis. The planning team considers economic growth, actual consumption changes, energy‑saving measures and other parameters, projecting high, medium and low scenarios. He reiterated that the annual compound growth rate has been lifted from 1.7% to 2.5%, and because AI will drive even higher demand, the ministry will use a higher estimate, expecting the revised growth rate to exceed 2.5% once details are finalized and announced. The currently prepared generation capacity can still fully support growth under the high‑estimate scenario.

Regarding the recent offshore wind turbine fire, Gong explained that this is the first incident since Taiwan installed more than 500 offshore turbines. The turbine was still in a “test‑grid‑connection” phase, which allows for technical adjustments. Preliminary investigations identified a single‑unit technical fault as the cause; other turbines were unaffected, and damage was limited to the unit’s rear and blades, without broader impact. The Ministry has asked the Energy Administration to continue probing the root cause.

Finally, on the progress of the 2026 supplemental budgets for Taipower and CPC, Gong said the Ministry has held multiple discussions and data exchanges with the Directorate‑General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics, but the overall pace must respect horizontal coordination with that agency and other ministries. He noted that supplemental budgets are typically submitted only after the annual budget passes the Legislative Yuan; if funding gaps remain, an additional request follows the proper procedure, and a smoothly passed budget would accelerate any subsequent supplemental funding implementation.

items.title: 萬潤產能滿載海外持續拓點 訂單能見度直達明年Q2
items.title_en: Wanrun's Capacity Fully Utilized, Expanding Overseas, Order Visibility Extends to Q2 2027
paras: 半導體設備廠萬潤(6187-TW)今(27)日參加櫃買業績發表會，發言人盧慧萱表示，受惠於AI浪潮帶動先進封裝需求強勁，目前產能利用率持續處於高檔滿載狀態，海外市場亦積極拓展服務與研發據點，依據目前掌握的客戶訂單與專案規劃，整體訂單能見度已清晰看到2027年第2季。
盧慧萱表示，萬潤深耕自動化、精密點膠、貼合、光學檢測及矽光子等五大領域。公司強調關鍵點膠膠閥堅持全數自行研發設計，能因應客戶不同膠水黏度與出膠路徑進行高度客製化；同時在晶片立體堆疊趨勢下，貼合設備已廣泛切入散熱片與系統單晶片封裝，並將單站設備串聯為一站式整合產線，大幅提升客戶良率控管效率。
針對次世代技術推進，盧慧萱指出，萬潤積極投入矽光子光耦合設備研發，為客戶提供涵蓋不同耦合製程與良率提升的完整解決方案，目前接洽產品皆屬全新專案，長線成長力道備受期待。
盧慧萱透露，在交期與認列節奏上，一般重複性量產機台在出貨後約1-2個月內驗收認列，新世代或客製化設備則需6-12個月驗證期，機台製造交期約落在3-8個月。
盧慧萱提到，萬潤採行輕資產營運模式，以研發設計為核心並搭配外包製造與彈性人力組裝，同時在美國、日本、馬來西亞以及台灣新竹、台中、高雄楠梓等地設立營運與研發服務據點。
透過在地化工程支援與跨場域製程一致性維護，公司持續深化與晶圓代工大廠及封測代工夥伴的合作，全力卡位先進封裝與矽光子商機。
paras_en: Semiconductor equipment maker Wanrun (6187‑TW) participated in today’s (27th) OTC earnings briefing. Spokesperson Lu Hui‑hsuan said that, boosted by the AI wave driving strong demand for advanced packaging, the company’s capacity utilization remains at a high, fully‑loaded level. Overseas markets are also actively expanding service and R&D sites, and based on current customer orders and project plans, overall order visibility clearly extends to the second quarter of 2027.

Lu explained that Wanrun focuses on five key areas: automation, precision dispensing, bonding, optical inspection, and silicon photonics. The company stresses that its critical dispensing valve is entirely developed in‑house, allowing highly customized solutions for different adhesive viscosities and dispensing paths. Meanwhile, with the trend toward three‑dimensional chip stacking, its bonding equipment has been widely applied to heatsinks and system‑in‑package (SiP) packaging, and single‑station machines are linked into a one‑stop integrated production line, greatly improving customers’ yield control efficiency.

Regarding next‑generation technology, Lu noted that Wanrun is actively investing in the development of silicon‑photonics optical coupling equipment, offering customers a complete solution covering various coupling processes and yield improvements. All products currently under discussion are brand‑new projects, and long‑term growth potential is highly anticipated.

Lu disclosed that for delivery and revenue recognition timing, standard repeat‑production machines are typically accepted and recognized within 1‑2 months after shipment, whereas next‑generation or customized equipment requires a 6‑12 month verification period. The manufacturing lead time for machines is roughly 3‑8 months.

Lu mentioned that Wanrun operates a light‑asset model, centering on R&D and design while outsourcing manufacturing and using flexible labor for assembly. The company has established operational and R&D service sites in the United States, Japan, Malaysia, and in Taiwan’s Hsinchu, Taichung, and Kaohsiung‑Nanzih regions.

Through localized engineering support and cross‑domain process consistency maintenance, the company continues to deepen cooperation with major wafer foundries and test‑packaging partners, fully positioning itself to capture opportunities in advanced packaging and silicon photonics.

items.title: 〈兆豐金法說〉前7月賺逾256億 非銀行貢獻衝新高 首揭「第二成長曲線」3大戰略
items.title_en: Mega Financial’s Earnings Briefing: Over NT$25.6 billion Profit in First Seven Months, Non‑Bank Contributions Reach New High, Unveils ‘Second Growth Curve’ and Three Strategic Pillars
paras: 兆豐金控 （2886-TW）今（27）日召開2026年第2季法人說明會，由總經理張傳章主持。受惠資本市場熱絡與AI供應鏈需求，兆豐金控上半年累計稅後淨利達213.07億元，年增17%，截至7月底累計稅後淨利更攀升至256.59億元。張傳章指出，非銀行子公司獲利動能爆發，對集團貢獻度大幅提高，第二成長曲線已非常清晰。展望未來，兆豐金將全力推動收益多元化、強化AI半導體跨境業務布局，並在升息與高利率環境下靈活調整資產配置。
2026年上半年全球經濟在科技投資熱潮與地緣政治變數間拉鋸。美國聯準會維持利率在3.50%至3.75%區間，高利率環境持續為金控業利差提供支撐。同時，台灣受惠AI供應鏈強勁需求，主計總處公佈上半年GDP成長率高達14.15%，創50年來同期新高。資本市場全面回溫，也給予證券及財富管理業務強勁動能。
集團整體營運體質顯著強化，兆豐金控上半年稅後淨利213.07億元，股東權益報酬率ROE升至10.72%、資產報酬率ROA達0.82%。若計入7月份，累計稅後淨利進一步達到256.59億元，年增14%，ROE與ROA分別微幅上調至11.10%與0.84%，展現極具韌性的獲利表現。
主要獲利引擎銀行子公司上半年稅後淨利158.66億元，年增約3%。主要受益於利差改善與放款規模擴張，淨利息收益年增9%。平均放款與存款餘額分別達到2.5兆元與3.3兆元，主要成長力道來自半導體、電子產業需求延續，以及企業跨境資金布局升溫。此外，配合金管會亞洲資產管理中心政策，上半年財富管理淨手續費達29億元，年增49%，高資產客群AUM更達2640億元，較去年底成長7%。
非銀行子公司表現極為亮眼，對集團獲利貢獻度由去年同期的13.53%大幅提升至27.98%，成為第二成長曲線。其中，證券子公司受益台股成交量能大增，上半年稅後淨利35.26億元，年增高達410%；票券子公司稅後淨利18億元，年增46%；產險子公司稅後淨利5.63億元，年增49%；投信與AMC子公司亦分別實現1.04億元及1.09億元獲利，創投子公司更順利扭虧為盈，貢獻0.63億元。
張傳章特別揭示未來營運的三大重點方向：第一，持續推動收益結構多元化，將財富管理與手續費收入作為中長期成長的核心主軸；第二，順應AI、半導體及全球供應鏈重組趨勢，深化企業金融與跨境業務布局，協助台商完成海外設點與全球資金調度；第三，在高利率延續的市場環境下，靈活調整資產負債與投資配置，維持充足資本與嚴謹風控，確保優異的資產品質。
paras_en: Mega Financial Holding (2886‑TW) held its 2026 Q2 institutional briefing today (27th), chaired by General Manager Zhang Chuan‑zhang. Benefiting from a hot capital market and AI supply‑chain demand, Mega Financial’s cumulative after‑tax net profit for the first half of the year reached NT$213.07 billion, up 17% year‑over‑year, and climbed to NT$256.59 billion by the end of July. Zhang noted that the profit momentum of non‑bank subsidiaries exploded, markedly raising their contribution to the group and making the second growth curve very clear. Looking ahead, Mega Financial will push for diversified earnings, strengthen its cross‑border AI semiconductor business, and flexibly adjust asset allocation in a rising‑rate, high‑interest‑rate environment.

The global economy in the first half of 2026 was tugged between a tech‑investment boom and geopolitical uncertainties. The U.S. Federal Reserve kept rates in the 3.50%‑3.75% range, and the high‑rate environment continued to support interest‑rate spreads for financial holding companies. Meanwhile, Taiwan benefited from strong AI‑supply‑chain demand, with the Directorate‑General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics reporting a 14.15% GDP growth for the first half – a 50‑year high for the same period. A broad market recovery also gave securities and wealth‑management businesses strong momentum.

The group’s overall operating strength improved markedly. Mega Financial’s after‑tax net profit for the first half was NT$213.07 billion, with return on equity (ROE) rising to 10.72% and return on assets (ROA) reaching 0.82%. Including July, cumulative after‑tax net profit reached NT$256.59 billion, a 14% year‑over‑year increase, and ROE and ROA were modestly revised up to 11.10% and 0.84% respectively, demonstrating highly resilient earnings performance.

The main profit engine, the banking subsidiary, posted after‑tax net profit of NT$158.66 billion for the first half, up about 3% year‑over‑year, driven by improved net interest margins and loan‑book expansion, with net interest income up 9% YoY. Average loan and deposit balances reached NT$2.5 trillion and NT$3.3 trillion respectively, powered mainly by continued demand from the semiconductor and electronics sectors and a warming of corporate cross‑border funding activities. In line with the Financial Supervisory Commission’s Asian Asset Management Center policy, wealth‑management net fees hit NT$2.9 billion, up 49% YoY, and high‑net‑worth client assets under management reached NT$264 billion, a 7% increase from year‑end.

Non‑bank subsidiaries performed exceptionally, raising their share of group profit from 13.53% a year ago to 27.98%, becoming the second growth curve. The securities arm benefited from a surge in Taiwan‑stock trading volume, delivering after‑tax net profit of NT$35.26 billion for the first half, up 410% YoY; the bond‑trading unit earned NT$18 billion, up 46%; the property‑insurance unit posted NT$5.63 billion, up 49%; mutual‑fund and asset‑management‑company units each earned NT$1.04 billion and NT$1.09 billion respectively, while the venture‑capital arm turned a loss into a profit of NT$0.63 billion.

Zhang highlighted three key future operating directions: first, continue diversifying the earnings structure by making wealth‑management and fee income the core of mid‑to‑long‑term growth; second, align with AI, semiconductor and global supply‑chain reshoring trends to deepen corporate finance and cross‑border business, helping Taiwanese firms establish overseas sites and manage global capital; third, in a persistently high‑interest‑rate market, flexibly adjust the balance sheet and investment allocation, maintain ample capital and rigorous risk control, and ensure superior asset quality.

items.title: 法國拋註銷18%公債訴求！全球恐走向「憑空抹債」加劇通膨
items.title_en: France Calls for Writing Off 18% of Public Debt! Global Fear of “Phantom Debt Erasure” Fuels Inflation
paras: 全球長天期公債殖利率持續攀升，高負債壓力也催生激進的「取消債務」主張。知名總體策略師、Variant Perception共同創辦人賽門懷特（Simon White）警告，這類思潮可能由法國蔓延至其他國家，全球債務週期恐步入透過貨幣融資「憑空抹債」的階段，最終恐加劇通膨並導致金融資產貶值。
懷特指出，全球金融危機時期的經典場景正在重演。法國左翼民粹派政治人物梅朗雄近期呼籲註銷該國18%的公共債務，甚至形容可將債券直接燒掉。類似主張並非首次出現，2009年歐債危機期間，歐洲和美國都曾出現相關討論。
問題在於，取消債務本質上只是另一種形式的貨幣融資，可能引發劇烈通膨，進一步強化「實體資產優於金融資產」的投資邏輯。
美國也曾提出類似構想。2011年，美國一度討論由財政部鑄造面額1兆美元的白金硬幣，再由聯準會以此兌換1兆美元政府債券，隨後由財政部註銷債券，以規避逼近的債務上限。
如今，美國距離再次觸及債務上限僅剩1.1兆美元，債務占國內生產毛額（GDP）比率則較15年前高出25個百分點，利息支出更已超過1兆美元。懷特認為，若美國政壇也出現要求註銷或削減部分公債的聲音，並不令人意外。
美國雙重赤字最令人憂心
懷特表示，美國的債務情勢仍是全球最令人擔憂的一環。以GDP占比計算，美國經常帳赤字與預算赤字合計的「雙重赤字」，規模超過除巴西以外的所有大型新興市場及已開發經濟體。
如此龐大的赤字，與美國目前所處的經濟週期並不相稱。部分原因來自利息支出激增，但即使排除利息負擔，美國無論以GDP占比或美元金額計算，仍擁有全球最大的赤字。
隨著西方政壇近年逐漸失去撤回財政刺激的意願，加上政治力量背離中間路線，轉向非傳統政策，取消債務等激進手段進入政治議程，已非無法想像。即使最終未付諸實施，這類低機率、高衝擊的尾部事件，也已改變市場的風險分布。
傳統減債選項愈來愈難
懷特認為，政府降低債務的方式包括財政整頓、經濟成長或通膨、金融壓抑、出售政府資產、債務違約或重組，以及取消債務或其他形式的貨幣融資。
然而，財政整頓可能在選舉中付出沉重代價；經濟成長受到龐大赤字拖累，通膨也因利息支出增加而升溫；金融壓抑即使終將出現，也可能為時已晚；出售黃金等政府資產則只是一次性措施，難以產生實質效果。相較之下，直接取消債務因執行相對容易，對政策制定者的吸引力可能日益上升。
「憑空抹債」恐引爆通膨
以美國為例，財政部可將聯準會持有的公債減記，例如削減10%，甚至直接註銷，再由聯準會把自身權益減記為負值。其他變形做法還包括鑄造白金硬幣、開放央行透支額度等，但本質都相同。
懷特指出，聯準會過去透過量化寬鬆（QE）創造的準備金，理應隨財政部償還到期債務而逐步註銷。一旦債務直接取消，準備金便失去回收時點，等同形成永久性的貨幣投放。
無論是配合財政擴張的QE、殖利率曲線控制，或由央行向財政部提供近乎無上限的融資，最終都可能推升通膨。只要各國繼續擱置痛苦但有效的財政改革，轉向取消債務等權宜手段，全球債務週期步入「憑空抹債」階段的尾部風險就將持續上升。
paras_en: Global long‑term sovereign bond yields keep climbing, and high debt burdens are spawning radical “debt cancellation” demands. Prominent macro strategist and Variant Perception co‑founder Simon White warned that this mindset could spread from France to other nations, pushing the world‑debt cycle into a phase of “phantom debt erasure” via monetary financing, ultimately worsening inflation and devaluing financial assets.

White noted that the classic scenario of a global financial crisis is replaying. France’s left‑wing populist politician Jean‑Luc Mélenchon recently called for writing off 18% of the country’s public debt, even suggesting the bonds could be burned outright. Similar proposals are not new; during the 2009 Euro‑debt crisis, comparable discussions surfaced in Europe and the United States.

The problem is that cancelling debt is essentially another form of monetary financing, which could spark severe inflation and further reinforce the investment logic that “real assets outrank financial assets.”

The United States has floated a similar idea. In 2011, there was a brief discussion about the Treasury minting a one‑trillion‑dollar platinum coin, which the Federal Reserve would exchange for one trillion dollars of government bonds, after which the Treasury would cancel the bonds to sidestep the looming debt ceiling.

Today the U.S. is only $1.1 trillion away from hitting the debt ceiling again, with debt‑to‑GDP ratios about 25 percentage points higher than 15 years ago, and interest outlays already exceeding $1 trillion. White believes it would not be surprising if voices in Washington also began demanding the write‑off or reduction of some sovereign debt.
The United States’ dual deficit is the most concerning

White said the U.S. debt situation remains the world’s biggest worry. Measured as a share of GDP, the combined “dual deficit” of the current‑account deficit and the budget deficit exceeds that of every large emerging market and developed economy except Brazil.

Such a massive deficit is out of sync with the U.S. economic cycle. Part of it stems from soaring interest costs, but even excluding interest burdens, the United States still carries the world’s largest deficit by either GDP share or dollar amount.

As Western politics has lately lost the appetite to roll back fiscal stimulus and political forces drift away from the centre toward unconventional policies, radical tools like debt cancellation have entered the political agenda. Even if never implemented, these low‑probability, high‑impact tail events have already reshaped market risk distribution.
Traditional debt‑reduction options are becoming increasingly difficult

White believes governments can lower debt through fiscal consolidation, growth or inflation, financial repression, selling state assets, default or restructuring, and debt cancellation or other forms of monetary financing.

However, fiscal consolidation may be costly in elections; growth is hampered by huge deficits; inflation is stoked by rising interest outlays; financial repression may arrive too late; and selling assets such as gold is a one‑off measure with limited effect. By contrast, outright debt cancellation is relatively easy to execute and may become more attractive to policymakers.
“Phantom debt erasure” could ignite inflation

Using the United States as an example, the Treasury could write down the Fed’s holdings of sovereign bonds—cutting them by, say, 10% or even canceling them outright—and then the Fed would record a negative equity position. Other variants include minting a platinum coin or opening unlimited central‑bank overdraft lines, but the essence is the same.

White pointed out that the reserves the Fed created through quantitative easing (QE) should be gradually retired as the Treasury repays maturing debt. If debt is cancelled directly, those reserves lose a redemption point, effectively creating a permanent monetary injection.

Whether through QE that accompanies fiscal expansion, yield‑curve control, or near‑limitless central‑bank financing of the Treasury, the end result can be higher inflation. As long as countries keep postponing painful but effective fiscal reforms and turn to stop‑gap measures like debt cancellation, the tail‑risk of the global debt cycle entering a “phantom debt erasure” phase will keep rising.

items.title: 輝達拋驚人長期財測！科技巨頭營收排名大洗牌 將超車蘋果Alphabet躍居第二
items.title_en: NVIDIA Unveils Stunning Long‑Term Forecast, Tech Giant Revenue Rankings Shift, Set to Overtake Apple and Alphabet
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)周三(26日)盤後公布大幅優於市場預期的財報，最新一季營收較去年同期翻倍，然而直到財務長在財報電話會議上拋出一項驚人預測，市場才更加震撼：明年營收將強勁成長。
輝達Colette Kress告訴投資人，輝達2028會計年度營收成長率將達70%，遠高於LSEG調查分析師平均預估的44%。
輝達目前處在2027會計年度(明年1月為止)，市場預估營收將達3960億美元，財務長的預測代表2028會計年度的營收將攀升到6730億美元。
CNBC報導，依華爾街預測，這將使輝達屆時的營收規模超越蘋果(AAPL-US)與Alphabet(GOOGL-US)，在美國科技公司中僅次於亞馬遜(AMZN-US)。不過，亞馬遜目前仍主要是一家零售商。
在人工智慧(AI)熱潮掀起前，輝達還只是相對小眾的晶片商，但隨著AI狂潮風起雲遠，輝達屢次締造驚人里程碑：輝達如今已成為全球市值最高的公司，且仍持續繳出歷史性的高速成長。
若不是受到供應限制影響，輝達的財測可能還會更高。輝達目前正面臨記憶體等零組件短缺問題，而隨著全球AI基礎建設大舉擴張，記憶體市場也陷入供應緊張。
輝達執行長黃仁勳在財報電話會議上表示：「我們的需求遠高於70%。供應量讓我們有信心實現70%的成長，而我們也將持續與供應鏈合作，進一步提高供應量。」
輝達過去並未發布如此長期的財測，不過黃仁勳過去幾年曾針對未來兩年的AI晶片銷售提供一些預估數據。
他在電話會議上告訴分析師，輝達之所以發布這項預測，是因為公司已能掌握明年對運算能力的需求。他表示，由於輝達晶片正推動大規模投資，因此希望與提供土地及電力的合作夥伴保持一致。
黃仁勳說：「每個人都投入大量資源，因此我們希望確保所有人掌握相同的資訊。」
輝達周三表示，隨著AI具備執行實際工作的能力，其技術需求正從超大規模、數十億美元的AI基礎建設投資，擴散至更廣泛的企業客戶。
投資人一直擔心，輝達的成長主要由少數大型科技公司、也就是所謂的「超大規模雲端業者」(hyperscalers)所推動。這些業者正大舉擴建資料中心，而這些資料中心最終很大一部分是為OpenAI等少數前沿AI實驗室提供運算能力。
黃仁勳周三表示，早期AI基礎建設擴張主要由「一家實驗室」推動，但情況已經改變，輝達如今的客戶基礎更加廣泛。
黃仁勳在財報聲明中說：「需求正在加速。去年此時，僅一家實驗室就帶動基礎建設擴張，如今，我們即將迎接AI實驗室與新創公司的黃金時代，多家前沿AI實驗室同步擴大規模，開放模型生態系蓬勃發展，實體AI也開始投入運作，在美國及全球各地都展現強勁動能。」
黃仁勳在財報電話會議上進一步透露，他看好有一類新客戶帶來更大的成長空間：ACIE，涵蓋區域型AI公司、Neocloud雲端業者、新創公司及企業。
他表示，輝達的技術對這群客戶具有吸引力，原因在於輝達不僅能提供晶片，還能提供資料中心的大量其他技術。他指出，這類客戶過去大多「不為人所見」。
輝達本月稍早宣布一項計畫，協助這類公司及前沿AI實驗室取得六家大型金融機構提供的融資。黃仁暈表示：「隨著時間推移，全球這部分的運算需求很可能會比我們目前在雲端看到的規模還要大。我們看到的需求，是所有這些因素共同推動的。」
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) announced on Wednesday (26th) after market close a financial report that far exceeded market expectations, with the latest quarter’s revenue doubling year‑on‑year. It was only when the CFO threw out a startling prediction during the earnings call that the market was truly shocked: revenue will grow strongly next year.
NVIDIA’s Colette Kress told investors that the company’s revenue growth rate for fiscal year 2028 will reach 70%, far above the 44% average forecast by LSEG survey analysts.
NVIDIA is currently in fiscal year 2027 (through next January), with market estimates of revenue at $396 billion. The CFO’s forecast represents fiscal year 2028 revenue rising to $673 billion.

CNBC reported that, according to Wall Street predictions, this will allow NVIDIA’s revenue size to surpass Apple (AAPL‑US) and Alphabet (GOOGL‑US), ranking only behind Amazon (AMZN‑US) among U.S. tech companies. However, Amazon remains primarily a retailer.

Before the AI boom, NVIDIA was still a relatively niche chipmaker, but as the AI frenzy escalated, NVIDIA repeatedly set remarkable milestones: it is now the world’s most valuable company and continues to deliver historic high‑speed growth.

If not for supply constraints, NVIDIA’s forecast could be even higher. The company is currently facing shortages of components such as memory, and as global AI infrastructure expands, the memory market is also experiencing supply tightness.

NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang said in the earnings call, "Our demand is far above 70%. The supply volume gives us confidence to achieve 70% growth, and we will continue to work with the supply chain to further increase supply."
NVIDIA has not previously issued such a long‑term forecast, but Huang has provided some estimates for AI chip sales over the next two years in recent years.

In the call, he told analysts that NVIDIA released this forecast because the company can now grasp next year’s demand for computing power. He said that because NVIDIA chips are driving large‑scale investment, the company hopes to align with partners that provide land and power.
Huang said, "Everyone is investing heavily, so we want to ensure everyone has the same information."

NVIDIA said on Wednesday that as AI gains the ability to perform real work, its technology demand is shifting from ultra‑large‑scale, multi‑billion‑dollar AI infrastructure investments to a broader range of enterprise customers.

Investors have long worried that NVIDIA’s growth is mainly driven by a few large tech companies, the so‑called "hyperscalers," which are massively expanding data centers, most of which ultimately provide computing power for a handful of cutting‑edge AI labs such as OpenAI.
Huang said on Wednesday that early AI infrastructure expansion was mainly driven by "one lab," but the situation has changed, and NVIDIA’s customer base is now broader.

In the earnings statement, Huang said, "Demand is accelerating. At this time last year, only one lab drove infrastructure expansion. Today, we are about to enter a golden age of AI labs and startups, multiple cutting‑edge AI labs are expanding simultaneously, the open‑model ecosystem is thriving, and physical AI is starting to operate, showing strong momentum in the U.S. and worldwide."

Huang further revealed in the earnings call that he is optimistic about a new type of customer that will bring even greater growth: ACIE, covering regional AI companies, Neocloud cloud providers, startups, and enterprises.

He said NVIDIA’s technology is attractive to these customers because NVIDIA can provide not only chips but also a wide range of other data‑center technologies. He noted that these customers were previously largely "invisible."

Earlier this month, NVIDIA announced a plan to help these companies and cutting‑edge AI labs obtain financing from six major financial institutions. Huang said, "Over time, the global computing demand in this segment is likely to be larger than what we currently see in the cloud. The demand we see is driven by all these factors together."

items.title: 溢價買下AI開發者天堂！輝達傳以129億美元收購Hugging Face 看好開源AI成下一成長引擎
items.title_en: Premium Paid for AI Developer's Paradise! Nvidia Said to Agree to $12.9 Billion Purchase of Hugging Face, Betting Open‑Source AI as the Next Growth Engine
paras: 《The Information》周三(26日)引述知情人士報導，輝達(NVDA-US)已同意以129億美元，收購開放原始碼人工智慧(AI)模型平台Hugging Face。若交易規模屬實，將成為輝達迄今最大規模收購案之一，也凸顯這家由黃仁勳領軍、身處AI熱潮核心的公司，仍押注AI技術需求將持續擴張。
《Business Insider》周三稍早則報導，雙方一直就收購案進行談判，Hugging Face的估值可能超過130億美元。

收購價遠高於公司營收

Hugging Face提供開放原始碼大型語言模型及資料集，屬於可以自由使用及修改的開源AI模型，這與強調控制權及私有性的封閉式AI形成對比。而目前Anthropic、OpenAI等開發封閉式模型的業者，都正尋求自行開發AI晶片，以降低對輝達GPU的依賴。
從報導披露的129億美元的收購價格來看，與Hugging Face每年約1.5億美元的營收形成巨大落差。根據《The Information》本周的稍早報導，Hugging Face年化營收約1.5億美元。
輝達曾與Salesforce(CRM-US)以及Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下Google等公司，在2023年共同參與Hugging Face某一輪2.35億美元的募資，當時對Hugging Face估值為45億美元。在那之後，輝達向整個AI生態系投入數十億美元，包括投資AI開發商OpenAI。
英國《金融時報》(FT)今年1月報導，Hugging Face去年拒絕輝達提出的5億美元投資案。若當時接受這項投資，Hugging Face的估值將達70億美元。

為何選中Hugging Face？

輝達押注AI需求強勁的策略，在周三公布財測時進一步獲得證實：該公司預估新一會計年度營收將成長70%，並表示截至2027年度，公司已承諾投入180億美元進行股權投資。
輝達執行長黃仁勳在周三財報電話會議上說：「全球將同時需要封閉式模型與開放模型(both closed models and open models )，而且這兩種模型的使用量都在快速飆升。」
他進一步補充，「幾乎所有開放式模型都在輝達的平台上運行」。
隨著開發者尋求更具成本效益的AI開發方式，開源AI正快速升溫，業者透過發布模型權重等內容，讓其他開發者能夠輕鬆在其成果上進一步開發。
Hugging Face將自己定位為AI開發者平台。該公司表示，平台讓AI開發者能輕鬆取得建立AI應用程式所需的各類工具，並與科技業其他開發者合作。
Hugging Face的使用者可以免費瀏覽、下載內容並進行其他活動，但Hugging Face也提供Pro訂閱服務，讓使用者「探索AI的完整領域，包括文字、圖像、影片、音訊、3D等」。訂閱服務也提供更高的運算能力，包括「最多40分鐘RTX Pro 6000 Blackwell」的運算資源，這是輝達的一款硬體產品。
這項收購報導發布前約一個月，Hugging Face才剛遭遇一起資安事件，當時由於OpenAI一款模型失控後觸發駭客攻擊，導致Hugging Face的基礎設施遭到入侵。
paras_en: The Information reported on Wednesday (the 26th) that Nvidia (NVDA-US) has agreed to acquire the open‑source AI model platform Hugging Face for $12.9 billion. If the deal size is accurate, it would be one of Nvidia’s largest acquisitions to date and underscores that the company, led by Jensen Huang and at the heart of the AI boom, still bets on a continued expansion of AI‑technology demand.
Business Insider reported earlier on Wednesday that the two sides have been negotiating the deal and that Hugging Face’s valuation could exceed $13 billion.

The acquisition price is far higher than the company’s revenue. Hugging Face provides open‑source large language models and datasets that can be freely used and modified, contrasting with closed‑AI systems that emphasize control and privacy. Companies such as Anthropic and OpenAI, which develop closed models, are currently seeking to build their own AI chips to reduce reliance on Nvidia GPUs.

At the disclosed price of $12.9 billion, the purchase price dwarfs Hugging Face’s roughly $150 million annual revenue. The Information earlier this week reported that Hugging Face’s annualized revenue is about $150 million.

Nvidia previously participated with Salesforce (CRM‑US) and Google, an Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) subsidiary, in a $235 million financing round for Hugging Face in 2023, which valued the company at $4.5 billion. Since then, Nvidia has poured tens of billions of dollars into the broader AI ecosystem, including investments in AI developer OpenAI.
The UK Financial Times reported in January that Hugging Face turned down a $500 million investment offer from Nvidia last year. Had the company accepted, its valuation would have risen to $7 billion.

Why choose Hugging Face? Nvidia’s strategy of betting on strong AI demand was further validated on Wednesday when it released its fiscal guidance, forecasting a 70% revenue growth for the next accounting year and pledging $18 billion in equity investments through 2027.
