Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said on the earnings call Wednesday, "The world will need both closed models and open models, and usage of both is accelerating rapidly."
He added, "Almost all open models run on Nvidia’s platform."

As developers look for more cost‑effective ways to build AI, open‑source AI is heating up quickly, with companies publishing model weights and other assets so that other developers can easily build on top of them.

Hugging Face positions itself as an AI developer platform. The company says the platform gives AI developers easy access to the variety of tools needed to build AI applications and to collaborate with other technologists.

Users can browse and download content for free and perform other activities, but Hugging Face also offers a Pro subscription that lets users "explore the full AI stack, including text, images, video, audio, 3D, and more." The subscription also provides higher compute power, including access to "up to 40‑minute RTX Pro 6000 Blackwell" resources, a hardware product from Nvidia.
The acquisition story was published about a month after Hugging Face suffered a security incident when a runaway OpenAI model triggered a hack that compromised the company’s infrastructure.

items.title: AI浪潮遇現實難題 美半數擬建資料中心被迫延期或取消
items.title_en: AI Wave Faces Real-World Challenges; Half of U.S. Planned Data Centers Forced to Delay or Cancel
paras: 美國人工智慧熱潮，正遭遇現實世界的嚴峻挑戰。根據能源投資機構 Kimmeridge Energy Management Co. 評估，美國高達半數已規劃的資料中心，正因政治反彈與實體資產建設的複雜性，面臨延宕或被迫取消的危機。
Kimmeridge 共同創辦人兼執行合夥人 Ben Dell 指出：「過去那種『矽谷模式』正迎面撞上現實世界中的基礎設施限制。」
這項發展也正直接衝擊能源市場，原本市場預期，隨着 AI 蓬勃發展帶動新發電廠建設，美國天然氣需求將隨之攀升，但資料中心的建設延宕恐將導致這些需求預測被迫下修。
雖然美國天然氣業者極力期盼 AI 能拉高天然氣消耗量，以提振因水力壓裂技術普及導致供應過剩、低迷近十年的氣價。然而，投資人對大型科技公司巨額支出的質疑，加上大眾對資料中心的反對，正為天然氣多頭市場增添逆風。
Dell 分析，在每日預估增長的 300 億立方英尺天然氣需求中，雖主要由液化天然氣(LNG)出口推動，但資料中心預計能貢獻約 50 億至 100 億立方英尺。一旦建設計畫延宕，AI 相關的天然氣消耗量恐將落在此預測區間的下限。
此外，政治阻力正從地方層級迅速擴大。Dell 警告，資料中心已迅速成為美國即將到來的期中選舉焦點議題，地方居民的抵制與訴訟將顯著拉高計畫中斷的風險。即便是在過去對資料中心極為友善的賓夕法尼亞州、德克薩斯州和俄亥俄州，如今跨黨派的反對聲浪也正在抬頭。
針對這場科技與地方社會的拉鋸，Dell 認為，最理想的資料中心提案應達到「零衝擊」(zero impact)，意即對當地的用水、土地、碳排放和電價皆不產生任何淨影響。
paras_en: The AI boom in the United States is confronting severe real‑world challenges. According to energy‑investment firm Kimmeridge Energy Management Co., up to half of the data centers planned in the U.S. are facing delays or even cancellation because of political backlash and the complexity of building physical assets.
Ben Dell, co‑founder and managing partner of Kimmeridge, said: “The old ‘Silicon Valley model’ is now running head‑on into infrastructure constraints in the real world.”

The development is also hitting the energy market directly. The market had expected that, as AI drives the construction of new power plants, U.S. natural‑gas demand would rise, but delays in data‑center construction could force those demand forecasts to be revised downward.

Although U.S. natural‑gas producers are eager for AI to boost gas consumption and lift prices that have been depressed for a decade by oversupply from widespread hydraulic fracturing, investor scepticism over massive spending by big‑tech firms and public opposition to data centers are adding headwinds to the gas‑bull market.

Dell estimates that of the daily incremental 30 billion cubic feet of gas demand, most is driven by LNG exports, but data centers are expected to contribute about 5 billion to 10 billion cubic feet. If construction plans are delayed, AI‑related gas consumption could fall to the lower end of that range.

Moreover, political resistance is rapidly spreading at the local level. Dell warns that data centers have become a focal issue for the upcoming U.S. midterm elections, and resident opposition and lawsuits will markedly raise the risk of project termination. Even in states that were previously very friendly to data centers—Pennsylvania, Texas and Ohio—bipartisan opposition is now emerging.

Regarding the tug‑of‑war between technology and local communities, Dell says the ideal data‑center proposal should achieve “zero impact,” meaning no net effect on local water use, land, carbon emissions or electricity prices.

items.title: 黃仁勳再駁「循環融資」質疑：回報龐大、風險很低
items.title_en: Jensen Huang Refutes "Circular Financing" Criticism: Huge Returns, Low Risk
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳周三再度反駁AI產業「循環融資」質疑，直言批評者「完全沒抓到重點」。他強調，前沿AI企業需要前所未見的龐大資本，輝達提供投資及財務支援，是為協助這些公司取得算力、擴大業務；即使個別企業陷入困境，相關運算設備仍可轉供其他客戶使用，因此整體風險很低。
近幾個月來，市場持續關注輝達在AI產業融資中扮演的角色。輝達除了大舉投資AI生態系企業，也與華爾街機構籌組數千億美元規模的資料中心融資平台，並為部分專案提供殘值擔保，引發外界質疑這類安排可能構成「循環融資」。
所謂循環融資，是指輝達透過股權投資、信用支持或商業擔保，協助客戶取得資金，客戶再將部分資金用於購買輝達硬體。批評者擔心，此舉可能人為推升晶片需求與輝達營收，一旦下游AI公司獲利不如預期，還可能帶來連鎖債務風險。
黃仁勳對此表示，AI是一個高度資本密集的產業，外界若以傳統新創公司的融資標準衡量，便忽略了建設AI基礎設施所需的龐大投入。
「這是第一代需要數百億美元融資的新創公司。」黃仁勳指出，過去從未出現一家新創公司需要數十億美元才能起步、數百億美元才能獲利，但這正是AI的特性，無論建設或部署AI，成本都極為高昂。
受惠於AI熱潮，輝達手握充沛現金，近年積極投資AI生態系企業，對象涵蓋OpenAI、Anthropic等模型開發商，以及向客戶出租輝達算力資源的「新雲端」服務業者。黃仁勳表示，這些前沿AI實驗室是「一代人才能一遇」的企業，輝達希望成為其投資人與合作夥伴，並支持這些公司採用輝達技術建立生態系、擴大業務規模。
他也指出，許多AI企業目前尚未具備投資級信用評等，也缺乏足夠的資本與財務紀錄，因此難以用較低成本借得資金、確保所需算力，而這正是輝達能夠發揮作用之處。
隨著AI基礎設施需求升高，輝達愈來愈多地運用自身強健的資產負債表，為資料中心專案提供財務支持。其中，公司將為俄亥俄州一座大型資料中心園區提供1,050億美元資金，OpenAI預計成為該園區租戶。輝達近期也宣布與多家華爾街頂級金融機構合作，為資料中心專案安排最高5,000億美元融資。
這波交易使市場疑慮進一步升高，部分批評者甚至將其與網路泡沫時期失敗的融資安排相提並論。不過，黃仁勳認為，輝達承擔的實際風險有限，因為相關運算基礎設施並非只能供單一客戶使用，即使其中一家企業陷入困境，設備仍能重新部署給其他客戶及工作負載。
「我們投入的資金將產生龐大回報，我認為風險很低。」黃仁勳表示。
輝達最新財報也反映AI晶片需求持續成長。2027會計年度第二季營收達962億美元，較去年同期成長逾一倍；資料中心營收年增117%至890億美元。公司並預估，2028會計年度營收將成長約70%。
財報公布後，輝達盤後股價上漲約4%；不過，今年以來股價僅上漲12%，顯示投資人對AI投資熱潮及相關融資風險仍抱持疑慮。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang on Wednesday again dismissed criticism of "circular financing" in the AI industry, saying critics "completely missed the point." He stressed that frontier AI companies require unprecedented massive capital, and NVIDIA’s investment and financial support help these firms obtain compute power and scale their businesses; even if an individual company runs into trouble, the related computing equipment can be redeployed to other customers, so overall risk is very low.

In recent months the market has been closely watching NVIDIA’s role in financing the AI sector. Beyond massive investments in AI‑ecosystem companies, NVIDIA has teamed up with Wall Street firms to create data‑center financing platforms worth hundreds of billions of dollars and has provided residual‑value guarantees for some projects, prompting concerns that such arrangements could amount to "circular financing."

Circular financing refers to NVIDIA helping customers obtain funding through equity investments, credit support or commercial guarantees, with customers then using part of the funds to purchase NVIDIA hardware. Critics worry this could artificially inflate chip demand and NVIDIA revenue, and if downstream AI firms underperform, it could trigger a chain‑reaction debt risk.
Huang said AI is a highly capital‑intensive industry, and judging it by the financing standards of traditional startups ignores the massive investment needed to build AI infrastructure.

"This is the first generation of startups that need hundreds of billions of dollars in financing," Huang noted, adding that never before has a startup required tens of billions just to get started and hundreds of billions to become profitable, but that is the nature of AI—both building and deploying it is extremely costly.

Benefiting from the AI boom, NVIDIA sits on abundant cash and has been actively investing in AI‑ecosystem firms in recent years, targeting model developers such as OpenAI and Anthropic as well as "new cloud" service providers that lease NVIDIA compute resources to customers. Huang said these frontier AI labs are "once‑in‑a‑generation" companies, and NVIDIA wants to be their investor and partner, supporting them in using NVIDIA technology to build ecosystems and expand their businesses.

He also pointed out that many AI firms currently lack investment‑grade credit ratings and sufficient capital and financial history, making it hard for them to borrow cheaply and secure the compute they need, which is precisely where NVIDIA can add value.

As demand for AI infrastructure rises, NVIDIA is increasingly leveraging its strong balance sheet to provide financial backing for data‑center projects. The company will fund a large data‑center campus in Ohio with $105 billion, with OpenAI expected to become a tenant. NVIDIA recently announced collaborations with several top Wall Street banks to arrange up to $500 billion in financing for data‑center projects.

The wave of deals has heightened market concerns, with some critics even likening them to the failed financing structures of the dot‑com bubble era. However, Huang believes NVIDIA’s actual risk exposure is limited because the computing infrastructure isn’t tied to a single customer; even if one firm falters, the equipment can be redeployed to other customers and workloads.
"The capital we put in will generate massive returns, and I think the risk is very low," Huang said.

NVIDIA’s latest earnings report also shows continued growth in AI chip demand. Revenue for Q2 of fiscal 2027 reached $96.2 billion, more than double year‑over‑year, while data‑center revenue grew 117% year‑over‑year to $89 billion. The company projects fiscal 2028 revenue to increase about 70%.

After the earnings release, NVIDIA’s after‑hours stock rose about 4%; however, the stock has only risen 12% year‑to‑date, indicating investors remain cautious about the AI investment frenzy and associated financing risks.

items.title: 華爾街最強多頭Yardeni：現在不會急著押AI 仍看好「咆哮的2020年代」
items.title_en: Wall Street’s Most Optimistic Bull, Yardeni: No Rush to Bet on AI, Still Confident in the "Roaring 2020s"
paras: 被稱為華爾街最樂觀人士的Ed Yardeni表示，他今年已三度上調標普500指數年終目標，從7,700點依序調高至8,250點、8,400點，但自認自己仍不夠樂觀。他同時指出，目前許多賣方分析師其實比他更加看多股市。
Yardeni Research總裁Ed Yardeni表示，目前人工智慧(AI)帶動的這波多頭行情與1990年代末的網路泡沫有很大不同。他認為，當時市場主要受到「害怕錯過」(FOMO)行情推動，現在則是他所稱的「亮眼獲利動能」(FEMO，fabulous earnings momentum)。
他指出，網路泡沫時期標普500的本益比急升，2000年初甚至達到25倍，資訊科技業的預估本益比更一度飆至約55倍。相較之下，現在市場的預估本益比反而下降。
Yardeni表示，目前半導體業本益比約17倍，整體市場約20倍，投資人遠不像1999年泡沫時期那樣願意給予科技股高估值。相反地，隨著分析師上修企業獲利預期，市場本益比反而下降。
他認為，這波多頭行情是由企業獲利帶動，而不是估值擴張，因此比當年的科技泡沫更具持續性，也沒有那麼令人擔憂。

看好「咆哮的2020年代」延續

Yardeni表示，他目前對「咆哮的2020年代」(Roaring 2020s)延續的主觀機率給出80%，另外20%則是市場可能出現嚴重問題的情境。
他表示，雖然仍有許多事情可能出錯，但不會因此完全放棄這項看法，而是會調整不同情境的主觀機率。
地緣政治是重大風險之一，不過歷史經驗顯示，危機往往也是買進機會。例如今年3月股市回檔約一個月後便反轉。
Yardeni認為，真正需要關注的是油價，因為油價上漲可能推升通膨，進而迫使各國央行升息。
他指出，美國與全球經濟過去已經相當程度承受住升息衝擊。2022及2023年聯準會基準利率從接近零一路升至5.5%，經濟仍維持韌性。
不過，他也提醒，熊市到來不一定需要伴隨經濟衰退的出現。2022年就是在沒有經濟衰退的情況下出現熊市，因此未來仍可能重演。

「現在不會急著跳進AI交易」

Yardeni的整體態度雖然極度樂觀，但並不代表他建議投資人現在追高AI類股。他認為，目前AI多頭行情的核心支撐是企業獲利持續改善，而不是單純靠估值膨脹，因此與網路泡沫不同。
換句話說，他看好AI帶動的長期生產力與獲利成長，但不認為投資人現在應該因為「害怕錯過」行情(FOMO)，而急著追進AI交易。

不認為美債殖利率會「長期維持高檔」

面對美國聯邦債務攀升，Yardeni表示，債務確實仍在他的「擔憂清單」上，但這個問題已經存在超過45年。
他在1983年創造「債券義勇軍」(bond vigilantes)一詞，當時指的是如果財政與貨幣當局無法維持資本市場及經濟秩序，債券市場投資人就會透過推高債券殖利率迫使政府採取行動。
Yardeni指出，1983年市場擔心的是一年約2500億美元的聯邦赤字，如今則是1.5兆至2兆美元。
但他不認同「利率將在高水準維持更久」(higher for longer)的看法，認為4%至5%的利率才是正常水準。
他甚至表示，等到「債券義勇軍」真正開始擔心債務危機時，他才會開始擔心。目前債券義勇軍已經活躍於日本與英國，美國市場也開始出現蠢蠢欲動的跡象。
paras_en: Ed Yardeni, dubbed the most optimistic figure on Wall Street, has raised his year‑end target for the S&P 500 three times this year, moving from 7,700 to 8,250 and then to 8,400 points, yet he admits he still isn’t optimistic enough. He also notes that many sell‑side analysts are actually more bullish on the market than he is.

Yardeni Research president Ed Yardeni says the current AI‑driven bull market differs greatly from the late‑1990s internet bubble. He argues that the bubble was driven by FOMO (fear of missing out), whereas today it is propelled by what he calls FEMO (fabulous earnings momentum).

He points out that during the internet bubble, the S&P 500’s price‑to‑earnings ratio surged, reaching 25× in early 2000, and the tech sector’s projected P/E even spiked to about 55×. In contrast, today’s market P/E has actually fallen.

Yardeni notes that the semiconductor sector’s P/E is around 17×, the overall market about 20×, and investors are far less willing to assign high valuations to tech stocks than they were in 1999. Instead, as analysts raise corporate earnings forecasts, the market P/E has declined.
He believes this bull run is driven by corporate earnings rather than valuation expansion, making it more sustainable than the tech bubble and less worrisome.
Yardeni assigns an 80% subjective probability to the continuation of the "Roaring 2020s", with the remaining 20% reflecting scenarios where the market could face serious problems.
He says that although many things could still go wrong, he won’t abandon this view entirely; instead, he will adjust the subjective probabilities for different scenarios.
Geopolitical risk is one major threat, but historical experience shows that crises often present buying opportunities. For example, the market fell in March and then reversed after about a month.
Yardeni believes the real focus should be on oil prices, as rising oil could spur inflation and force central banks to hike rates.
He points out that the U.S. and global economies have already absorbed significant rate hikes: the Fed’s policy rate rose from near zero to 5.5% in 2022 and 2023, yet the economy remained resilient.
However, he cautions that a bear market can occur without an economic recession. The 2022 bear market happened without a recession, so a similar pattern could recur.

"I’m not rushing into AI trading," Yardeni says. Despite his overall optimism, he does not advise investors to chase AI stocks now. He believes the core support for the AI bull is ongoing earnings improvement, not mere valuation inflation, unlike the internet bubble.
In other words, he is bullish on AI’s long‑term productivity and earnings growth, but he does not think investors should be driven by FOMO to jump into AI stocks at this moment.
He does not think U.S. Treasury yields will "stay high for long." Facing rising federal debt, Yardeni says the debt issue remains on his "concern list" but has existed for over 45 years.

He coined the term "bond vigilantes" in 1983 to describe investors who would raise Treasury yields to force governments to act if fiscal and monetary authorities failed to maintain market and economic order.
Yardeni notes that in 1983 the market worried about a $250 billion annual deficit, whereas today the deficit is $1.5–2 trillion.
He disagrees with the view that rates will stay high for longer, arguing that 4%–5% is the normal range.

He even says he will only worry when the "bond vigilantes" truly start to worry about a debt crisis. Currently, bond vigilantes are active in Japan and the UK, and the U.S. market is beginning to show signs of agitation.

items.title: 美PCE通膨攀升但消費停滯 專家：投資優質股票遠比擔憂經濟重要
items.title_en: US PCE Inflation Rises but Consumption Stagnates: Experts Say Investing in Quality Stocks Is Far More Important Than Worrying About the Economy
paras: 根據美國商務部經濟分析局(BEA)數據，美國7月個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數年增率攀升至3.7%，扣除食品與能源的核心PCE則年增3.3%。儘管頑強的通膨可能引發市場對經濟衰退的擔憂，但標普500指數對此反應平淡，最終平盤收市。
這份數據還透露出消費者行為的結構性轉變。從月增率來看，7月份個人所得成長0.4%，個人支出僅增0.2%，實質個人消費支出成長甚至不到0.1%，使得個人儲蓄率上升3%。這顯示儘管所得增加，實質消費支出卻已趨於停滯。
對此，專欄作家Isac Simon認為，這反而是一個正面訊號。Simon指出，消費者不再盲目接受廠商漲價，而是重新調整消費比重(服務支出月增862億美元，商品支出則減少499億美元)。
Simon強調：「這並非空頭支持者所稱的『需求毀滅』，精明的投資人會將其視為一場『理智的買方罷工』。」 這種消費降溫將迫使企業降價，進而有助於壓低未來通膨，為降息環境與股市估值鋪路。
在投資策略上，Simon警告，目前美國10年期公債殖利率低於4.7%，而標普500指數的盈餘殖利率僅3.38%，使得大盤指數投資吸引力下滑。他建議投資人避開指數型投資，轉向「強勁自由現金流」且具「定價權」的優質企業。
Simon解釋，高自由現金流的企業在銷售放緩時，無需舉債即可維持營運，還能運用充裕現金配息或進行股份回購。他點名微軟(MSFT-US)、與輝達(NVDA-US)等「現金流複利機器」。微軟的雲端事業在2026財年第四季營收超過590億美元(年增27%)，訂閱業務難以取代；輝達的GPU更是AI基礎建設，客戶更在乎其創造的價值而非售價。
此外，Simon也看好寶僑(PG-US)這類防守型企業。他指出，即使成本因通膨上升，強大的品牌仍能維持定價權，穩定帶動現金流與股息成長以超越通膨。
Simon總結，雖然悲觀情緒可能引發短期震盪，但長期而言，在投資組合中持有約50檔優質個股，才是安度波動的關鍵。
paras_en: According to data from the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA), the U.S. July Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index rose 3.7% year‑over‑year, while core PCE excluding food and energy increased 3.3% year‑over‑year. Despite the stubborn inflation that could spark market concerns about a recession, the S&P 500 reacted mildly and closed flat.

The data also reveal a structural shift in consumer behavior. On a month‑over‑month basis, personal income grew 0.4% in July, personal spending increased only 0.2%, and real personal consumption spending grew less than 0.1%, causing the personal savings rate to rise 3%. This shows that even though income rose, real consumption spending has become stagnant.

Columnist Isac Simon argues that this is actually a positive signal. Simon points out that consumers no longer blindly accept price hikes from vendors, but instead are readjusting their spending mix (service spending rose 86.2 billion USD, while goods spending fell 49.9 billion USD).

Simon emphasizes, "This is not the 'demand destruction' called out by short‑sellers; savvy investors will see it as a 'reasonable buyer strike.'" The cooling of consumption will force companies to cut prices, which in turn helps lower future inflation and paves the way for a lower‑interest‑rate environment and stock‑market valuations.

In terms of investment strategy, Simon warns that the U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield is below 4.7%, while the S&P 500’s earnings yield is only 3.38%, reducing the attractiveness of index investing. He advises investors to avoid index funds and instead focus on high‑quality companies with strong free cash flow and pricing power.

Simon explains that companies with high free cash flow can sustain operations without borrowing when sales slow, and can use excess cash for dividends or share buybacks. He names Microsoft (MSFT‑US) and NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) as "cash‑flow compounding machines." Microsoft’s cloud business generated over 59 billion USD in revenue in FY26 Q4 (27% year‑over‑year), and its subscription business is irreplaceable; NVIDIA’s GPUs are the backbone of AI infrastructure, and customers care more about the value created than the price.

Additionally, Simon is bullish on defensive firms like Procter & Gamble (PG‑US). He notes that even if costs rise with inflation, a strong brand can maintain pricing power, stabilizing cash flow and dividend growth to outpace inflation.
Simon concludes that while pessimism may trigger short‑term volatility, holding about 50 high‑quality individual stocks in a portfolio is the key to weathering long‑term market swings.

items.title: SpaceX砸錢沒極限 華爾街卻樂見其成
items.title_en: SpaceX Spends Without Limit, Wall Street Welcomes It
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，SpaceX(SPCX-US)正砸下大筆資金，而華爾街對此卻相當樂觀。
SpaceX周二宣布計劃在路易斯安那州興建新的太空基地(Starbase Louisiana)。SpaceX目前從加州與佛羅里達州的政府所有基地發射火箭，也在德州波卡契卡(Boca Chica)的Starbase營運。
這座新設施旨在提升SpaceX大型且可完全重複使用Starship火箭的發射能力，目前Starship仍處於測試階段。Starship對SpaceX至關重要，因它能大幅降低進入太空的成本，進而實現包括軌道AI資料中心在內的各種應用。
興建AI資料中心可能耗資龐大。根據FactSet，華爾街預估SpaceX到2031年將在新廠房與設備上支出1.4兆美元。分析師預期，公司未來幾年還需要至少籌集2,000億美元，以支應其成長計畫。
Starbase Louisiana未來將再耗資1,000億美元。這是一筆龐大資金，但相較於1.4兆美元而言，只是九牛一毛。
華爾街並不擔心這些支出。摩根士丹利分析師Adam Jonas表示，這座基地代表SpaceX將採取「更積極的」發射節奏。SpaceX最終希望每年執行數千次Starship任務。這些任務將搭載設備，而這些設備將為SpaceX帶來營收。
路易斯安那州基地並未納入Jonas的預測模型。他的模型預估SpaceX到2040年營收將達到3.5兆美元。更快的發射速度意味著SpaceX可能更早達到這項營收水準。
Wolfe Research分析師Myles Walton表示，Starbase Louisiana以及白宮近期發布、旨在放寬發射監管規定的行政命令，都是SpaceX雄心的「利多訊號」。理由與Jonas的看法類似：發射次數越多，馬斯克(Elon Musk)旗下這家火箭與AI公司創造營收的潛力就越大。
Jonas與Walton均給予SpaceX股票「買進」評級。Walton的目標價為175美元，Jonas給出300美元。根據FactSet，整體而言，追蹤SpaceX股票的分析師中，有75%給予「買進」評級。相比之下，標普500指數成分股獲得「買進」評級的分析師比例通常介於55%至60%。
分析師對SpaceX股票的平均目標價約為226美元。
SpaceX周三上漲1.2%，收於139.63美元，而標普500指數則收平。該股周二已上漲2.2%，新宣布的Starbase是影響當日交易因素之一。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reported that SpaceX (SPCX-US) is pouring large amounts of money into its operations, and Wall Street is surprisingly optimistic about it.

SpaceX announced on Tuesday its plan to build a new space base in Louisiana (Starbase Louisiana). Currently, SpaceX launches rockets from government-owned bases in California and Florida, and operates the Starbase at Boca Chica, Texas.

The new facility is intended to boost the launch capacity of SpaceX’s large, fully reusable Starship rockets, which are still in the testing phase. Starship is crucial to SpaceX because it can dramatically lower the cost of reaching space, enabling a range of applications including orbital AI data centers.

Building an AI data center could be enormously costly. According to FactSet, Wall Street estimates that SpaceX will spend $1.4 trillion on new factories and equipment through 2031. Analysts expect the company will need to raise at least $200 billion over the next few years to fund its growth plans.
Starbase Louisiana is projected to require an additional $100 billion in spending. While a huge sum, it is a drop in the bucket compared with the $1.4 trillion figure.

Wall Street is not worried about these expenditures. Morgan Stanley analyst Adam Jonas said the base signals that SpaceX will adopt a “more aggressive” launch cadence. SpaceX ultimately hopes to conduct several thousand Starship missions per year, each carrying payloads that will generate revenue for the company.

The Louisiana base was not included in Jonas’s forecasting model. His model projects SpaceX revenue to reach $3.5 trillion by 2040. A faster launch rate could mean SpaceX hits that revenue level even sooner.

Wolfe Research analyst Myles Walton said Starbase Louisiana and the recent White House executive order aimed at loosening launch‑regulation rules are “bullish signals” for SpaceX’s ambitions. He shares Jonas’s view: the more launches, the greater the revenue‑generating potential for Elon Musk’s rocket and AI firm.

Both Jonas and Walton gave SpaceX stock a “Buy” rating. Walton’s price target is $175, while Jonas’s is $300. FactSet reports that overall, 75% of analysts covering SpaceX assign a “Buy” rating, compared with the typical 55%‑60% for S&P 500 constituents.
Analysts’ average price target for SpaceX stock is about $226.

SpaceX rose 1.2% on Wednesday, closing at $139.63, while the S&P 500 was flat. The stock had already gained 2.2% on Tuesday, with the newly announced Starbase cited as one of the day’s trading drivers.

items.title: 法國拋註銷18%公債訴求！全球恐走向「憑空抹債」加劇通膨
items.title_en: France Calls for Writing Off 18% of Public Debt! Global Fear of “Phantom Debt Erasure” Fuels Inflation
paras: 全球長天期公債殖利率持續攀升，高負債壓力也催生激進的「取消債務」主張。知名總體策略師、Variant Perception共同創辦人賽門懷特（Simon White）警告，這類思潮可能由法國蔓延至其他國家，全球債務週期恐步入透過貨幣融資「憑空抹債」的階段，最終恐加劇通膨並導致金融資產貶值。
懷特指出，全球金融危機時期的經典場景正在重演。法國左翼民粹派政治人物梅朗雄近期呼籲註銷該國18%的公共債務，甚至形容可將債券直接燒掉。類似主張並非首次出現，2009年歐債危機期間，歐洲和美國都曾出現相關討論。
問題在於，取消債務本質上只是另一種形式的貨幣融資，可能引發劇烈通膨，進一步強化「實體資產優於金融資產」的投資邏輯。
美國也曾提出類似構想。2011年，美國一度討論由財政部鑄造面額1兆美元的白金硬幣，再由聯準會以此兌換1兆美元政府債券，隨後由財政部註銷債券，以規避逼近的債務上限。
如今，美國距離再次觸及債務上限僅剩1.1兆美元，債務占國內生產毛額（GDP）比率則較15年前高出25個百分點，利息支出更已超過1兆美元。懷特認為，若美國政壇也出現要求註銷或削減部分公債的聲音，並不令人意外。
美國雙重赤字最令人憂心
懷特表示，美國的債務情勢仍是全球最令人擔憂的一環。以GDP占比計算，美國經常帳赤字與預算赤字合計的「雙重赤字」，規模超過除巴西以外的所有大型新興市場及已開發經濟體。
如此龐大的赤字，與美國目前所處的經濟週期並不相稱。部分原因來自利息支出激增，但即使排除利息負擔，美國無論以GDP占比或美元金額計算，仍擁有全球最大的赤字。
隨著西方政壇近年逐漸失去撤回財政刺激的意願，加上政治力量背離中間路線，轉向非傳統政策，取消債務等激進手段進入政治議程，已非無法想像。即使最終未付諸實施，這類低機率、高衝擊的尾部事件，也已改變市場的風險分布。
傳統減債選項愈來愈難
懷特認為，政府降低債務的方式包括財政整頓、經濟成長或通膨、金融壓抑、出售政府資產、債務違約或重組，以及取消債務或其他形式的貨幣融資。
然而，財政整頓可能在選舉中付出沉重代價；經濟成長受到龐大赤字拖累，通膨也因利息支出增加而升溫；金融壓抑即使終將出現，也可能為時已晚；出售黃金等政府資產則只是一次性措施，難以產生實質效果。相較之下，直接取消債務因執行相對容易，對政策制定者的吸引力可能日益上升。
「憑空抹債」恐引爆通膨
以美國為例，財政部可將聯準會持有的公債減記，例如削減10%，甚至直接註銷，再由聯準會把自身權益減記為負值。其他變形做法還包括鑄造白金硬幣、開放央行透支額度等，但本質都相同。
懷特指出，聯準會過去透過量化寬鬆（QE）創造的準備金，理應隨財政部償還到期債務而逐步註銷。一旦債務直接取消，準備金便失去回收時點，等同形成永久性的貨幣投放。
無論是配合財政擴張的QE、殖利率曲線控制，或由央行向財政部提供近乎無上限的融資，最終都可能推升通膨。只要各國繼續擱置痛苦但有效的財政改革，轉向取消債務等權宜手段，全球債務週期步入「憑空抹債」階段的尾部風險就將持續上升。
paras_en: Global long‑term sovereign bond yields keep climbing, and high debt burdens are spawning radical “debt cancellation” demands. Prominent macro strategist and Variant Perception co‑founder Simon White warned that this mindset could spread from France to other nations, pushing the world‑debt cycle into a phase of “phantom debt erasure” via monetary financing, ultimately worsening inflation and devaluing financial assets.

White noted that the classic scenario of a global financial crisis is replaying. France’s left‑wing populist politician Jean‑Luc Mélenchon recently called for writing off 18% of the country’s public debt, even suggesting the bonds could be burned outright. Similar proposals are not new; during the 2009 Euro‑debt crisis, comparable discussions surfaced in Europe and the United States.

The problem is that cancelling debt is essentially another form of monetary financing, which could spark severe inflation and further reinforce the investment logic that “real assets outrank financial assets.”

The United States has floated a similar idea. In 2011, there was a brief discussion about the Treasury minting a one‑trillion‑dollar platinum coin, which the Federal Reserve would exchange for one trillion dollars of government bonds, after which the Treasury would cancel the bonds to sidestep the looming debt ceiling.

Today the U.S. is only $1.1 trillion away from hitting the debt ceiling again, with debt‑to‑GDP ratios about 25 percentage points higher than 15 years ago, and interest outlays already exceeding $1 trillion. White believes it would not be surprising if voices in Washington also began demanding the write‑off or reduction of some sovereign debt.
The United States’ dual deficit is the most concerning

White said the U.S. debt situation remains the world’s biggest worry. Measured as a share of GDP, the combined “dual deficit” of the current‑account deficit and the budget deficit exceeds that of every large emerging market and developed economy except Brazil.

Such a massive deficit is out of sync with the U.S. economic cycle. Part of it stems from soaring interest costs, but even excluding interest burdens, the United States still carries the world’s largest deficit by either GDP share or dollar amount.

As Western politics has lately lost the appetite to roll back fiscal stimulus and political forces drift away from the centre toward unconventional policies, radical tools like debt cancellation have entered the political agenda. Even if never implemented, these low‑probability, high‑impact tail events have already reshaped market risk distribution.
Traditional debt‑reduction options are becoming increasingly difficult

White believes governments can lower debt through fiscal consolidation, growth or inflation, financial repression, selling state assets, default or restructuring, and debt cancellation or other forms of monetary financing.

However, fiscal consolidation may be costly in elections; growth is hampered by huge deficits; inflation is stoked by rising interest outlays; financial repression may arrive too late; and selling assets such as gold is a one‑off measure with limited effect. By contrast, outright debt cancellation is relatively easy to execute and may become more attractive to policymakers.
“Phantom debt erasure” could ignite inflation

Using the United States as an example, the Treasury could write down the Fed’s holdings of sovereign bonds—cutting them by, say, 10% or even canceling them outright—and then the Fed would record a negative equity position. Other variants include minting a platinum coin or opening unlimited central‑bank overdraft lines, but the essence is the same.

White pointed out that the reserves the Fed created through quantitative easing (QE) should be gradually retired as the Treasury repays maturing debt. If debt is cancelled directly, those reserves lose a redemption point, effectively creating a permanent monetary injection.

Whether through QE that accompanies fiscal expansion, yield‑curve control, or near‑limitless central‑bank financing of the Treasury, the end result can be higher inflation. As long as countries keep postponing painful but effective fiscal reforms and turn to stop‑gap measures like debt cancellation, the tail‑risk of the global debt cycle entering a “phantom debt erasure” phase will keep rising.

items.title: AI需求推升銅箔基板景氣建滔積層板迎量價齊升、目標價升至42.43港元
items.title_en: AI Demand Drives Copper Foil Substrate Boom, Kingboard Laminates Sees Volume and Price Rise, Target Price Raised to HK$42.43
paras: 2026年08月27日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI伺服器需求快速擴張，帶動銅箔基板(CCL)產業進入量價齊升週期。大華繼顯UOB Kay Hian最新研究報告指出，受惠銅箔基板及上游原料售價走高，加上供給持續吃緊，全球主要銅箔基板廠建滔積層板Kingboard Laminates(1888-HK)今年下半年獲利可望明顯受惠。
這波景氣不只來自AI伺服器出貨增加，PCB層數提高、高階HDI(高密度互連)滲透率提升，以及材料規格升級，都同步推升銅箔基板的單機用量與價值。
根據高盛最新預估，全球AI伺服器PCB市場規模2027年將達375億美元，較先前預測上調38%，2028年進一步增至840億美元；銅箔基板市場2027年預估達221億美元，上調18%，2028年則有望增至480億美元。2026年至2028年，AI伺服器PCB與銅箔基板市場規模複合年增長率預估分別達148%及161%。
需求快速成長之際，供給端仍相對吃緊。2026年以來，銅箔基板與上游電子布供需持續偏緊，電子布上半年已歷經五輪漲價，7月價格進一步走高。花旗先前預估，銅箔基板廠商將持續推動漲價，建滔相關產品2026年8月銷售均價可能調升約10%至15%。
對建滔積層板而言，目前傳統銅箔基板的量價改善已率先支撐獲利，高階AI材料則有望接棒成為下一階段成長動能。大華繼顯尤其看好AI相關特殊紗料，預估該業務占公司總營收比重將由2026年的3.3%，快速提高至2027年的10.6%，2028年進一步升至12.8%。
在產品價格與AI需求展望同步轉強下，大華繼顯將建滔積層板2026年、2027年及2028年營收預估分別上修13%、11%及14%，維持「買進」評等，並將目標價由25.30港元大幅調升至42.43港元，調幅超過六成。
消息激勵建滔積層板8月27日股價上漲9.3%，報43.48港元。
值得注意的是，銅箔基板產業目前雖處於供需緊張階段，高景氣也正吸引業者加速擴產。由於新增產能仍需經歷建廠、設備導入及客戶認證，未來6至12個月供給偏緊局面仍可能延續；但隨著2027年至2028年新產能陸續投產，供需是否逐步轉向平衡將成為後續景氣的重要觀察指標。
此外，銅價與電子布等上游成本持續走高，也可能抵銷部分產品漲價效益。對建滔積層板而言，接下來除了觀察銅箔基板漲價能否延續，AI特殊紗料與高頻高速材料的放量速度，以及產品售價與原料成本之間的利差變化，將是獲利能否持續成長的關鍵。

paras_en: On August 27, 2026 (Yuan Analysis/Industry Data Center Report) – Rapid expansion of AI server demand is pushing the copper foil substrate (CCL) industry into a period of simultaneous volume and price growth. According to the latest research report from Dahua and UOB Kay Hian, the high prices of copper foil substrates and upstream raw materials, combined with tightening supply, will significantly benefit Kingboard Laminates (1888‑HK) in the second half of this year.

This boom is not only driven by increased AI server shipments, but also by higher PCB layer counts, greater penetration of high‑end HDI (high‑density interconnect), and upgraded material specifications, all of which simultaneously raise the per‑unit usage and value of copper foil substrates.

According to the latest Goldman Sachs estimates, the global AI server PCB market is projected to reach US$37.5 billion in 2027, a 38% upward revision from earlier forecasts, and further to US$84 billion in 2028. The copper foil substrate market is expected to reach US$22.1 billion in 2027, an 18% increase, and US$48 billion in 2028. From 2026 to 2028, the compound annual growth rates for AI server PCBs and copper foil substrates are estimated at 148% and 161%, respectively.

While demand is growing rapidly, supply remains relatively tight. Since 2026, the supply of copper foil substrates and upstream electronic cloth has continued to be constrained, with electronic cloth having undergone five rounds of price increases in the first half of the year, and July prices rising further. Citi previously estimated that copper foil substrate manufacturers will continue to push price hikes, with Kingboard’s related products potentially seeing a price increase of about 10% to 15% in August 2026.

For Kingboard Laminates, the current improvement in volume and price of traditional copper foil substrates has already supported profitability, and high‑end AI materials are expected to become the next growth driver. Dahua and UOB Kay Hian are particularly bullish on AI‑related specialty yarns, estimating that this business will account for 3.3% of the company’s total revenue in 2026, rising rapidly to 10.6% in 2027, and further to 12.8% in 2028.

With product prices and AI demand outlooks strengthening simultaneously, Dahua and UOB Kay Hian have raised their revenue estimates for Kingboard Laminates for 2026, 2027, and 2028 by 13%, 11%, and 14%, respectively, maintaining a “Buy” rating and raising the target price from HK$25.30 to HK$42.43, an increase of more than 60%.
The news prompted Kingboard Laminates’ stock to rise 9.3% on August 27, trading at HK$43.48.

It is worth noting that although the copper foil substrate industry is currently in a tight supply‑demand phase, the high economic cycle is also attracting operators to accelerate production expansion. Because new capacity still requires plant construction, equipment installation, and customer certification, the supply‑tight situation may continue for the next 6 to 12 months; however, as new capacity comes online from 2027 to 2028, whether supply and demand gradually balance will become an important indicator of future economic conditions.

In addition, rising copper prices and upstream costs such as electronic cloth may offset some of the product price gains. For Kingboard Laminates, the key to sustained profitability will be to monitor whether copper foil substrate price hikes continue, the volume growth of AI specialty yarns and high‑frequency high‑speed materials, and the changes in the margin between product selling prices and raw material costs.

items.title: 輝達拋驚人長期財測！科技巨頭營收排名大洗牌 將超車蘋果Alphabet躍居第二
items.title_en: NVIDIA Unveils Stunning Long‑Term Forecast, Tech Giant Revenue Rankings Shift, Set to Overtake Apple and Alphabet
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)周三(26日)盤後公布大幅優於市場預期的財報，最新一季營收較去年同期翻倍，然而直到財務長在財報電話會議上拋出一項驚人預測，市場才更加震撼：明年營收將強勁成長。
輝達Colette Kress告訴投資人，輝達2028會計年度營收成長率將達70%，遠高於LSEG調查分析師平均預估的44%。
輝達目前處在2027會計年度(明年1月為止)，市場預估營收將達3960億美元，財務長的預測代表2028會計年度的營收將攀升到6730億美元。
CNBC報導，依華爾街預測，這將使輝達屆時的營收規模超越蘋果(AAPL-US)與Alphabet(GOOGL-US)，在美國科技公司中僅次於亞馬遜(AMZN-US)。不過，亞馬遜目前仍主要是一家零售商。
在人工智慧(AI)熱潮掀起前，輝達還只是相對小眾的晶片商，但隨著AI狂潮風起雲遠，輝達屢次締造驚人里程碑：輝達如今已成為全球市值最高的公司，且仍持續繳出歷史性的高速成長。
若不是受到供應限制影響，輝達的財測可能還會更高。輝達目前正面臨記憶體等零組件短缺問題，而隨著全球AI基礎建設大舉擴張，記憶體市場也陷入供應緊張。
輝達執行長黃仁勳在財報電話會議上表示：「我們的需求遠高於70%。供應量讓我們有信心實現70%的成長，而我們也將持續與供應鏈合作，進一步提高供應量。」
輝達過去並未發布如此長期的財測，不過黃仁勳過去幾年曾針對未來兩年的AI晶片銷售提供一些預估數據。
他在電話會議上告訴分析師，輝達之所以發布這項預測，是因為公司已能掌握明年對運算能力的需求。他表示，由於輝達晶片正推動大規模投資，因此希望與提供土地及電力的合作夥伴保持一致。
黃仁勳說：「每個人都投入大量資源，因此我們希望確保所有人掌握相同的資訊。」
輝達周三表示，隨著AI具備執行實際工作的能力，其技術需求正從超大規模、數十億美元的AI基礎建設投資，擴散至更廣泛的企業客戶。
投資人一直擔心，輝達的成長主要由少數大型科技公司、也就是所謂的「超大規模雲端業者」(hyperscalers)所推動。這些業者正大舉擴建資料中心，而這些資料中心最終很大一部分是為OpenAI等少數前沿AI實驗室提供運算能力。
黃仁勳周三表示，早期AI基礎建設擴張主要由「一家實驗室」推動，但情況已經改變，輝達如今的客戶基礎更加廣泛。
黃仁勳在財報聲明中說：「需求正在加速。去年此時，僅一家實驗室就帶動基礎建設擴張，如今，我們即將迎接AI實驗室與新創公司的黃金時代，多家前沿AI實驗室同步擴大規模，開放模型生態系蓬勃發展，實體AI也開始投入運作，在美國及全球各地都展現強勁動能。」
黃仁勳在財報電話會議上進一步透露，他看好有一類新客戶帶來更大的成長空間：ACIE，涵蓋區域型AI公司、Neocloud雲端業者、新創公司及企業。
他表示，輝達的技術對這群客戶具有吸引力，原因在於輝達不僅能提供晶片，還能提供資料中心的大量其他技術。他指出，這類客戶過去大多「不為人所見」。
輝達本月稍早宣布一項計畫，協助這類公司及前沿AI實驗室取得六家大型金融機構提供的融資。黃仁暈表示：「隨著時間推移，全球這部分的運算需求很可能會比我們目前在雲端看到的規模還要大。我們看到的需求，是所有這些因素共同推動的。」
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) announced on Wednesday (26th) after market close a financial report that far exceeded market expectations, with the latest quarter’s revenue doubling year‑on‑year. It was only when the CFO threw out a startling prediction during the earnings call that the market was truly shocked: revenue will grow strongly next year.
NVIDIA’s Colette Kress told investors that the company’s revenue growth rate for fiscal year 2028 will reach 70%, far above the 44% average forecast by LSEG survey analysts.
NVIDIA is currently in fiscal year 2027 (through next January), with market estimates of revenue at $396 billion. The CFO’s forecast represents fiscal year 2028 revenue rising to $673 billion.

CNBC reported that, according to Wall Street predictions, this will allow NVIDIA’s revenue size to surpass Apple (AAPL‑US) and Alphabet (GOOGL‑US), ranking only behind Amazon (AMZN‑US) among U.S. tech companies. However, Amazon remains primarily a retailer.

Before the AI boom, NVIDIA was still a relatively niche chipmaker, but as the AI frenzy escalated, NVIDIA repeatedly set remarkable milestones: it is now the world’s most valuable company and continues to deliver historic high‑speed growth.

If not for supply constraints, NVIDIA’s forecast could be even higher. The company is currently facing shortages of components such as memory, and as global AI infrastructure expands, the memory market is also experiencing supply tightness.

NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang said in the earnings call, "Our demand is far above 70%. The supply volume gives us confidence to achieve 70% growth, and we will continue to work with the supply chain to further increase supply."
NVIDIA has not previously issued such a long‑term forecast, but Huang has provided some estimates for AI chip sales over the next two years in recent years.

In the call, he told analysts that NVIDIA released this forecast because the company can now grasp next year’s demand for computing power. He said that because NVIDIA chips are driving large‑scale investment, the company hopes to align with partners that provide land and power.
Huang said, "Everyone is investing heavily, so we want to ensure everyone has the same information."

NVIDIA said on Wednesday that as AI gains the ability to perform real work, its technology demand is shifting from ultra‑large‑scale, multi‑billion‑dollar AI infrastructure investments to a broader range of enterprise customers.

Investors have long worried that NVIDIA’s growth is mainly driven by a few large tech companies, the so‑called "hyperscalers," which are massively expanding data centers, most of which ultimately provide computing power for a handful of cutting‑edge AI labs such as OpenAI.
Huang said on Wednesday that early AI infrastructure expansion was mainly driven by "one lab," but the situation has changed, and NVIDIA’s customer base is now broader.

In the earnings statement, Huang said, "Demand is accelerating. At this time last year, only one lab drove infrastructure expansion. Today, we are about to enter a golden age of AI labs and startups, multiple cutting‑edge AI labs are expanding simultaneously, the open‑model ecosystem is thriving, and physical AI is starting to operate, showing strong momentum in the U.S. and worldwide."

Huang further revealed in the earnings call that he is optimistic about a new type of customer that will bring even greater growth: ACIE, covering regional AI companies, Neocloud cloud providers, startups, and enterprises.

He said NVIDIA’s technology is attractive to these customers because NVIDIA can provide not only chips but also a wide range of other data‑center technologies. He noted that these customers were previously largely "invisible."

Earlier this month, NVIDIA announced a plan to help these companies and cutting‑edge AI labs obtain financing from six major financial institutions. Huang said, "Over time, the global computing demand in this segment is likely to be larger than what we currently see in the cloud. The demand we see is driven by all these factors together."

items.title: 溢價買下AI開發者天堂！輝達傳以129億美元收購Hugging Face 看好開源AI成下一成長引擎
items.title_en: Premium Paid for AI Developer's Paradise! Nvidia Said to Agree to $12.9 Billion Purchase of Hugging Face, Betting Open‑Source AI as the Next Growth Engine
paras: 《The Information》周三(26日)引述知情人士報導，輝達(NVDA-US)已同意以129億美元，收購開放原始碼人工智慧(AI)模型平台Hugging Face。若交易規模屬實，將成為輝達迄今最大規模收購案之一，也凸顯這家由黃仁勳領軍、身處AI熱潮核心的公司，仍押注AI技術需求將持續擴張。
《Business Insider》周三稍早則報導，雙方一直就收購案進行談判，Hugging Face的估值可能超過130億美元。

收購價遠高於公司營收

Hugging Face提供開放原始碼大型語言模型及資料集，屬於可以自由使用及修改的開源AI模型，這與強調控制權及私有性的封閉式AI形成對比。而目前Anthropic、OpenAI等開發封閉式模型的業者，都正尋求自行開發AI晶片，以降低對輝達GPU的依賴。
從報導披露的129億美元的收購價格來看，與Hugging Face每年約1.5億美元的營收形成巨大落差。根據《The Information》本周的稍早報導，Hugging Face年化營收約1.5億美元。
輝達曾與Salesforce(CRM-US)以及Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下Google等公司，在2023年共同參與Hugging Face某一輪2.35億美元的募資，當時對Hugging Face估值為45億美元。在那之後，輝達向整個AI生態系投入數十億美元，包括投資AI開發商OpenAI。
英國《金融時報》(FT)今年1月報導，Hugging Face去年拒絕輝達提出的5億美元投資案。若當時接受這項投資，Hugging Face的估值將達70億美元。

為何選中Hugging Face？

輝達押注AI需求強勁的策略，在周三公布財測時進一步獲得證實：該公司預估新一會計年度營收將成長70%，並表示截至2027年度，公司已承諾投入180億美元進行股權投資。
輝達執行長黃仁勳在周三財報電話會議上說：「全球將同時需要封閉式模型與開放模型(both closed models and open models )，而且這兩種模型的使用量都在快速飆升。」
他進一步補充，「幾乎所有開放式模型都在輝達的平台上運行」。
隨著開發者尋求更具成本效益的AI開發方式，開源AI正快速升溫，業者透過發布模型權重等內容，讓其他開發者能夠輕鬆在其成果上進一步開發。
Hugging Face將自己定位為AI開發者平台。該公司表示，平台讓AI開發者能輕鬆取得建立AI應用程式所需的各類工具，並與科技業其他開發者合作。
Hugging Face的使用者可以免費瀏覽、下載內容並進行其他活動，但Hugging Face也提供Pro訂閱服務，讓使用者「探索AI的完整領域，包括文字、圖像、影片、音訊、3D等」。訂閱服務也提供更高的運算能力，包括「最多40分鐘RTX Pro 6000 Blackwell」的運算資源，這是輝達的一款硬體產品。
這項收購報導發布前約一個月，Hugging Face才剛遭遇一起資安事件，當時由於OpenAI一款模型失控後觸發駭客攻擊，導致Hugging Face的基礎設施遭到入侵。
paras_en: The Information reported on Wednesday (the 26th) that Nvidia (NVDA-US) has agreed to acquire the open‑source AI model platform Hugging Face for $12.9 billion. If the deal size is accurate, it would be one of Nvidia’s largest acquisitions to date and underscores that the company, led by Jensen Huang and at the heart of the AI boom, still bets on a continued expansion of AI‑technology demand.
Business Insider reported earlier on Wednesday that the two sides have been negotiating the deal and that Hugging Face’s valuation could exceed $13 billion.

The acquisition price is far higher than the company’s revenue. Hugging Face provides open‑source large language models and datasets that can be freely used and modified, contrasting with closed‑AI systems that emphasize control and privacy. Companies such as Anthropic and OpenAI, which develop closed models, are currently seeking to build their own AI chips to reduce reliance on Nvidia GPUs.

At the disclosed price of $12.9 billion, the purchase price dwarfs Hugging Face’s roughly $150 million annual revenue. The Information earlier this week reported that Hugging Face’s annualized revenue is about $150 million.

Nvidia previously participated with Salesforce (CRM‑US) and Google, an Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) subsidiary, in a $235 million financing round for Hugging Face in 2023, which valued the company at $4.5 billion. Since then, Nvidia has poured tens of billions of dollars into the broader AI ecosystem, including investments in AI developer OpenAI.
The UK Financial Times reported in January that Hugging Face turned down a $500 million investment offer from Nvidia last year. Had the company accepted, its valuation would have risen to $7 billion.

Why choose Hugging Face? Nvidia’s strategy of betting on strong AI demand was further validated on Wednesday when it released its fiscal guidance, forecasting a 70% revenue growth for the next accounting year and pledging $18 billion in equity investments through 2027.
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said on the earnings call Wednesday, "The world will need both closed models and open models, and usage of both is accelerating rapidly."
He added, "Almost all open models run on Nvidia’s platform."

As developers look for more cost‑effective ways to build AI, open‑source AI is heating up quickly, with companies publishing model weights and other assets so that other developers can easily build on top of them.

Hugging Face positions itself as an AI developer platform. The company says the platform gives AI developers easy access to the variety of tools needed to build AI applications and to collaborate with other technologists.

Users can browse and download content for free and perform other activities, but Hugging Face also offers a Pro subscription that lets users "explore the full AI stack, including text, images, video, audio, 3D, and more." The subscription also provides higher compute power, including access to "up to 40‑minute RTX Pro 6000 Blackwell" resources, a hardware product from Nvidia.
The acquisition story was published about a month after Hugging Face suffered a security incident when a runaway OpenAI model triggered a hack that compromised the company’s infrastructure.

items.title: AI浪潮遇現實難題 美半數擬建資料中心被迫延期或取消
items.title_en: AI Wave Faces Real-World Challenges; Half of U.S. Planned Data Centers Forced to Delay or Cancel
paras: 美國人工智慧熱潮，正遭遇現實世界的嚴峻挑戰。根據能源投資機構 Kimmeridge Energy Management Co. 評估，美國高達半數已規劃的資料中心，正因政治反彈與實體資產建設的複雜性，面臨延宕或被迫取消的危機。
Kimmeridge 共同創辦人兼執行合夥人 Ben Dell 指出：「過去那種『矽谷模式』正迎面撞上現實世界中的基礎設施限制。」
這項發展也正直接衝擊能源市場，原本市場預期，隨着 AI 蓬勃發展帶動新發電廠建設，美國天然氣需求將隨之攀升，但資料中心的建設延宕恐將導致這些需求預測被迫下修。
雖然美國天然氣業者極力期盼 AI 能拉高天然氣消耗量，以提振因水力壓裂技術普及導致供應過剩、低迷近十年的氣價。然而，投資人對大型科技公司巨額支出的質疑，加上大眾對資料中心的反對，正為天然氣多頭市場增添逆風。
Dell 分析，在每日預估增長的 300 億立方英尺天然氣需求中，雖主要由液化天然氣(LNG)出口推動，但資料中心預計能貢獻約 50 億至 100 億立方英尺。一旦建設計畫延宕，AI 相關的天然氣消耗量恐將落在此預測區間的下限。
此外，政治阻力正從地方層級迅速擴大。Dell 警告，資料中心已迅速成為美國即將到來的期中選舉焦點議題，地方居民的抵制與訴訟將顯著拉高計畫中斷的風險。即便是在過去對資料中心極為友善的賓夕法尼亞州、德克薩斯州和俄亥俄州，如今跨黨派的反對聲浪也正在抬頭。
針對這場科技與地方社會的拉鋸，Dell 認為，最理想的資料中心提案應達到「零衝擊」(zero impact)，意即對當地的用水、土地、碳排放和電價皆不產生任何淨影響。
paras_en: The AI boom in the United States is confronting severe real‑world challenges. According to energy‑investment firm Kimmeridge Energy Management Co., up to half of the data centers planned in the U.S. are facing delays or even cancellation because of political backlash and the complexity of building physical assets.
Ben Dell, co‑founder and managing partner of Kimmeridge, said: “The old ‘Silicon Valley model’ is now running head‑on into infrastructure constraints in the real world.”

The development is also hitting the energy market directly. The market had expected that, as AI drives the construction of new power plants, U.S. natural‑gas demand would rise, but delays in data‑center construction could force those demand forecasts to be revised downward.

Although U.S. natural‑gas producers are eager for AI to boost gas consumption and lift prices that have been depressed for a decade by oversupply from widespread hydraulic fracturing, investor scepticism over massive spending by big‑tech firms and public opposition to data centers are adding headwinds to the gas‑bull market.

Dell estimates that of the daily incremental 30 billion cubic feet of gas demand, most is driven by LNG exports, but data centers are expected to contribute about 5 billion to 10 billion cubic feet. If construction plans are delayed, AI‑related gas consumption could fall to the lower end of that range.

Moreover, political resistance is rapidly spreading at the local level. Dell warns that data centers have become a focal issue for the upcoming U.S. midterm elections, and resident opposition and lawsuits will markedly raise the risk of project termination. Even in states that were previously very friendly to data centers—Pennsylvania, Texas and Ohio—bipartisan opposition is now emerging.

Regarding the tug‑of‑war between technology and local communities, Dell says the ideal data‑center proposal should achieve “zero impact,” meaning no net effect on local water use, land, carbon emissions or electricity prices.

items.title: 黃仁勳再駁「循環融資」質疑：回報龐大、風險很低
items.title_en: Jensen Huang Refutes "Circular Financing" Criticism: Huge Returns, Low Risk
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳周三再度反駁AI產業「循環融資」質疑，直言批評者「完全沒抓到重點」。他強調，前沿AI企業需要前所未見的龐大資本，輝達提供投資及財務支援，是為協助這些公司取得算力、擴大業務；即使個別企業陷入困境，相關運算設備仍可轉供其他客戶使用，因此整體風險很低。
近幾個月來，市場持續關注輝達在AI產業融資中扮演的角色。輝達除了大舉投資AI生態系企業，也與華爾街機構籌組數千億美元規模的資料中心融資平台，並為部分專案提供殘值擔保，引發外界質疑這類安排可能構成「循環融資」。
所謂循環融資，是指輝達透過股權投資、信用支持或商業擔保，協助客戶取得資金，客戶再將部分資金用於購買輝達硬體。批評者擔心，此舉可能人為推升晶片需求與輝達營收，一旦下游AI公司獲利不如預期，還可能帶來連鎖債務風險。
黃仁勳對此表示，AI是一個高度資本密集的產業，外界若以傳統新創公司的融資標準衡量，便忽略了建設AI基礎設施所需的龐大投入。
「這是第一代需要數百億美元融資的新創公司。」黃仁勳指出，過去從未出現一家新創公司需要數十億美元才能起步、數百億美元才能獲利，但這正是AI的特性，無論建設或部署AI，成本都極為高昂。
受惠於AI熱潮，輝達手握充沛現金，近年積極投資AI生態系企業，對象涵蓋OpenAI、Anthropic等模型開發商，以及向客戶出租輝達算力資源的「新雲端」服務業者。黃仁勳表示，這些前沿AI實驗室是「一代人才能一遇」的企業，輝達希望成為其投資人與合作夥伴，並支持這些公司採用輝達技術建立生態系、擴大業務規模。
他也指出，許多AI企業目前尚未具備投資級信用評等，也缺乏足夠的資本與財務紀錄，因此難以用較低成本借得資金、確保所需算力，而這正是輝達能夠發揮作用之處。
隨著AI基礎設施需求升高，輝達愈來愈多地運用自身強健的資產負債表，為資料中心專案提供財務支持。其中，公司將為俄亥俄州一座大型資料中心園區提供1,050億美元資金，OpenAI預計成為該園區租戶。輝達近期也宣布與多家華爾街頂級金融機構合作，為資料中心專案安排最高5,000億美元融資。
這波交易使市場疑慮進一步升高，部分批評者甚至將其與網路泡沫時期失敗的融資安排相提並論。不過，黃仁勳認為，輝達承擔的實際風險有限，因為相關運算基礎設施並非只能供單一客戶使用，即使其中一家企業陷入困境，設備仍能重新部署給其他客戶及工作負載。
「我們投入的資金將產生龐大回報，我認為風險很低。」黃仁勳表示。
輝達最新財報也反映AI晶片需求持續成長。2027會計年度第二季營收達962億美元，較去年同期成長逾一倍；資料中心營收年增117%至890億美元。公司並預估，2028會計年度營收將成長約70%。
財報公布後，輝達盤後股價上漲約4%；不過，今年以來股價僅上漲12%，顯示投資人對AI投資熱潮及相關融資風險仍抱持疑慮。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang on Wednesday again dismissed criticism of "circular financing" in the AI industry, saying critics "completely missed the point." He stressed that frontier AI companies require unprecedented massive capital, and NVIDIA’s investment and financial support help these firms obtain compute power and scale their businesses; even if an individual company runs into trouble, the related computing equipment can be redeployed to other customers, so overall risk is very low.

In recent months the market has been closely watching NVIDIA’s role in financing the AI sector. Beyond massive investments in AI‑ecosystem companies, NVIDIA has teamed up with Wall Street firms to create data‑center financing platforms worth hundreds of billions of dollars and has provided residual‑value guarantees for some projects, prompting concerns that such arrangements could amount to "circular financing."

Circular financing refers to NVIDIA helping customers obtain funding through equity investments, credit support or commercial guarantees, with customers then using part of the funds to purchase NVIDIA hardware. Critics worry this could artificially inflate chip demand and NVIDIA revenue, and if downstream AI firms underperform, it could trigger a chain‑reaction debt risk.
Huang said AI is a highly capital‑intensive industry, and judging it by the financing standards of traditional startups ignores the massive investment needed to build AI infrastructure.

"This is the first generation of startups that need hundreds of billions of dollars in financing," Huang noted, adding that never before has a startup required tens of billions just to get started and hundreds of billions to become profitable, but that is the nature of AI—both building and deploying it is extremely costly.

Benefiting from the AI boom, NVIDIA sits on abundant cash and has been actively investing in AI‑ecosystem firms in recent years, targeting model developers such as OpenAI and Anthropic as well as "new cloud" service providers that lease NVIDIA compute resources to customers. Huang said these frontier AI labs are "once‑in‑a‑generation" companies, and NVIDIA wants to be their investor and partner, supporting them in using NVIDIA technology to build ecosystems and expand their businesses.

He also pointed out that many AI firms currently lack investment‑grade credit ratings and sufficient capital and financial history, making it hard for them to borrow cheaply and secure the compute they need, which is precisely where NVIDIA can add value.

As demand for AI infrastructure rises, NVIDIA is increasingly leveraging its strong balance sheet to provide financial backing for data‑center projects. The company will fund a large data‑center campus in Ohio with $105 billion, with OpenAI expected to become a tenant. NVIDIA recently announced collaborations with several top Wall Street banks to arrange up to $500 billion in financing for data‑center projects.

The wave of deals has heightened market concerns, with some critics even likening them to the failed financing structures of the dot‑com bubble era. However, Huang believes NVIDIA’s actual risk exposure is limited because the computing infrastructure isn’t tied to a single customer; even if one firm falters, the equipment can be redeployed to other customers and workloads.
"The capital we put in will generate massive returns, and I think the risk is very low," Huang said.

NVIDIA’s latest earnings report also shows continued growth in AI chip demand. Revenue for Q2 of fiscal 2027 reached $96.2 billion, more than double year‑over‑year, while data‑center revenue grew 117% year‑over‑year to $89 billion. The company projects fiscal 2028 revenue to increase about 70%.

After the earnings release, NVIDIA’s after‑hours stock rose about 4%; however, the stock has only risen 12% year‑to‑date, indicating investors remain cautious about the AI investment frenzy and associated financing risks.

items.title: 波斯灣小國重啟「接駁貿易」 推升荷姆茲海峽原油流量
items.title_en: Small Gulf States Revive "Shuttle Trade" Boosting Crude Oil Flows Through the Hormuz Strait
paras: 波斯灣地區兩大較小原油生產國科威特與卡達，正持續增加經由荷姆茲海峽運送的原油量，此舉有助於穩定全球油價。
據貿易商透露，這兩國在伊朗戰爭爆發前合計每日出口200萬桶原油，目前其出貨量已成功恢復至衝突前的7成左右。在此之前，阿拉伯聯合大公國率先利用「接駁運輸」在阿曼灣進行海上轉運，隨後沙烏地阿拉伯也因紅海油輪遭受胡塞武裝組織攻擊，而被迫轉向依賴荷姆茲海峽運作。
目前，每日經由荷姆茲海峽運出的原油總量已從7月中旬的約400萬桶，增加至700萬到800萬桶，約達戰前水準的四分之三。儘管美伊雙方對該海峽的控制權仍僵持不下，但海峽原油流量的上升已使基準布蘭特原油價格從4月底的每桶120美元以上，回落至約87美元附近。
這項「接駁貿易」的興起，主要是因為極少數船隻願意承擔穿越荷姆茲海峽的風險。海灣產油國因此動用自身船隊或以極高昂的運費雇用油輪，將原油運出海峽後，再轉運至其他船隻。
科威特主要動用旗下11艘超級油輪的自有船隊，且多數油輪已關閉衛星定位系統(俗稱「隱形」)超過兩個月；儘管其超級油輪曾在8月遭襲，科威特仍成功將原油推向現貨市場。
相較之下，卡達主要依賴商業油輪船隊(如道達爾能源公司)來運送原油，卡達能源公司甚至在本周推出於阿曼灣海峽外進行船對船轉運的銷售方案。
paras_en: The two smaller crude oil producers in the Persian Gulf, Kuwait and Qatar, are continuously increasing the amount of oil shipped through the Hormuz Strait, a move that helps stabilize global oil prices.

According to traders, the two countries together exported 2 million barrels per day before the Iran war broke out, and their shipments have now recovered to about 70% of pre‑conflict levels. Earlier, the United Arab Emirates was the first to use "shuttle transport" for offshore transshipment in the Gulf of Oman, and Saudi Arabia later, after its Red Sea tankers were attacked by Houthi forces, was forced to rely on operations through the Hormuz Strait.

Currently, the total daily crude oil volume exported via the Hormuz Strait has risen from about 4 million barrels in mid‑July to between 7 million and 8 million barrels, roughly three‑quarters of pre‑war levels. Although the United States and Iran remain deadlocked over control of the strait, the increase in oil flow has pulled Brent crude prices down from above $120 per barrel at the end of April to around $87.

The rise of this "shuttle trade" is mainly because only a few vessels are willing to take the risk of transiting the Hormuz Strait. Gulf oil producers therefore deploy their own fleets or hire tankers at very high freight rates to move crude out of the strait and then transfer it to other ships.

Kuwait mainly uses its own fleet of 11 supertankers, many of which have had their satellite tracking systems turned off ("stealth mode") for more than two months; despite a supertanker being attacked in August, Kuwait still succeeded in pushing crude onto the spot market.

By contrast, Qatar relies mainly on commercial tanker fleets such as those of TotalEnergies to transport its crude, and Qatar Energy even launched a ship‑to‑ship transfer sales scheme this week outside the Gulf of Oman.

items.title: 華爾街最強多頭Yardeni：現在不會急著押AI 仍看好「咆哮的2020年代」
items.title_en: Wall Street’s Most Optimistic Bull, Yardeni: No Rush to Bet on AI, Still Confident in the "Roaring 2020s"
paras: 被稱為華爾街最樂觀人士的Ed Yardeni表示，他今年已三度上調標普500指數年終目標，從7,700點依序調高至8,250點、8,400點，但自認自己仍不夠樂觀。他同時指出，目前許多賣方分析師其實比他更加看多股市。
Yardeni Research總裁Ed Yardeni表示，目前人工智慧(AI)帶動的這波多頭行情與1990年代末的網路泡沫有很大不同。他認為，當時市場主要受到「害怕錯過」(FOMO)行情推動，現在則是他所稱的「亮眼獲利動能」(FEMO，fabulous earnings momentum)。
他指出，網路泡沫時期標普500的本益比急升，2000年初甚至達到25倍，資訊科技業的預估本益比更一度飆至約55倍。相較之下，現在市場的預估本益比反而下降。
Yardeni表示，目前半導體業本益比約17倍，整體市場約20倍，投資人遠不像1999年泡沫時期那樣願意給予科技股高估值。相反地，隨著分析師上修企業獲利預期，市場本益比反而下降。
他認為，這波多頭行情是由企業獲利帶動，而不是估值擴張，因此比當年的科技泡沫更具持續性，也沒有那麼令人擔憂。

看好「咆哮的2020年代」延續

Yardeni表示，他目前對「咆哮的2020年代」(Roaring 2020s)延續的主觀機率給出80%，另外20%則是市場可能出現嚴重問題的情境。
他表示，雖然仍有許多事情可能出錯，但不會因此完全放棄這項看法，而是會調整不同情境的主觀機率。
地緣政治是重大風險之一，不過歷史經驗顯示，危機往往也是買進機會。例如今年3月股市回檔約一個月後便反轉。
Yardeni認為，真正需要關注的是油價，因為油價上漲可能推升通膨，進而迫使各國央行升息。
他指出，美國與全球經濟過去已經相當程度承受住升息衝擊。2022及2023年聯準會基準利率從接近零一路升至5.5%，經濟仍維持韌性。
不過，他也提醒，熊市到來不一定需要伴隨經濟衰退的出現。2022年就是在沒有經濟衰退的情況下出現熊市，因此未來仍可能重演。

「現在不會急著跳進AI交易」

Yardeni的整體態度雖然極度樂觀，但並不代表他建議投資人現在追高AI類股。他認為，目前AI多頭行情的核心支撐是企業獲利持續改善，而不是單純靠估值膨脹，因此與網路泡沫不同。
換句話說，他看好AI帶動的長期生產力與獲利成長，但不認為投資人現在應該因為「害怕錯過」行情(FOMO)，而急著追進AI交易。

不認為美債殖利率會「長期維持高檔」

面對美國聯邦債務攀升，Yardeni表示，債務確實仍在他的「擔憂清單」上，但這個問題已經存在超過45年。
他在1983年創造「債券義勇軍」(bond vigilantes)一詞，當時指的是如果財政與貨幣當局無法維持資本市場及經濟秩序，債券市場投資人就會透過推高債券殖利率迫使政府採取行動。
Yardeni指出，1983年市場擔心的是一年約2500億美元的聯邦赤字，如今則是1.5兆至2兆美元。
但他不認同「利率將在高水準維持更久」(higher for longer)的看法，認為4%至5%的利率才是正常水準。
他甚至表示，等到「債券義勇軍」真正開始擔心債務危機時，他才會開始擔心。目前債券義勇軍已經活躍於日本與英國，美國市場也開始出現蠢蠢欲動的跡象。
paras_en: Ed Yardeni, dubbed the most optimistic figure on Wall Street, has raised his year‑end target for the S&P 500 three times this year, moving from 7,700 to 8,250 and then to 8,400 points, yet he admits he still isn’t optimistic enough. He also notes that many sell‑side analysts are actually more bullish on the market than he is.

Yardeni Research president Ed Yardeni says the current AI‑driven bull market differs greatly from the late‑1990s internet bubble. He argues that the bubble was driven by FOMO (fear of missing out), whereas today it is propelled by what he calls FEMO (fabulous earnings momentum).

He points out that during the internet bubble, the S&P 500’s price‑to‑earnings ratio surged, reaching 25× in early 2000, and the tech sector’s projected P/E even spiked to about 55×. In contrast, today’s market P/E has actually fallen.

Yardeni notes that the semiconductor sector’s P/E is around 17×, the overall market about 20×, and investors are far less willing to assign high valuations to tech stocks than they were in 1999. Instead, as analysts raise corporate earnings forecasts, the market P/E has declined.
He believes this bull run is driven by corporate earnings rather than valuation expansion, making it more sustainable than the tech bubble and less worrisome.
Yardeni assigns an 80% subjective probability to the continuation of the "Roaring 2020s", with the remaining 20% reflecting scenarios where the market could face serious problems.
He says that although many things could still go wrong, he won’t abandon this view entirely; instead, he will adjust the subjective probabilities for different scenarios.
Geopolitical risk is one major threat, but historical experience shows that crises often present buying opportunities. For example, the market fell in March and then reversed after about a month.
Yardeni believes the real focus should be on oil prices, as rising oil could spur inflation and force central banks to hike rates.
He points out that the U.S. and global economies have already absorbed significant rate hikes: the Fed’s policy rate rose from near zero to 5.5% in 2022 and 2023, yet the economy remained resilient.
However, he cautions that a bear market can occur without an economic recession. The 2022 bear market happened without a recession, so a similar pattern could recur.

"I’m not rushing into AI trading," Yardeni says. Despite his overall optimism, he does not advise investors to chase AI stocks now. He believes the core support for the AI bull is ongoing earnings improvement, not mere valuation inflation, unlike the internet bubble.
In other words, he is bullish on AI’s long‑term productivity and earnings growth, but he does not think investors should be driven by FOMO to jump into AI stocks at this moment.
He does not think U.S. Treasury yields will "stay high for long." Facing rising federal debt, Yardeni says the debt issue remains on his "concern list" but has existed for over 45 years.

He coined the term "bond vigilantes" in 1983 to describe investors who would raise Treasury yields to force governments to act if fiscal and monetary authorities failed to maintain market and economic order.
Yardeni notes that in 1983 the market worried about a $250 billion annual deficit, whereas today the deficit is $1.5–2 trillion.
He disagrees with the view that rates will stay high for longer, arguing that 4%–5% is the normal range.

He even says he will only worry when the "bond vigilantes" truly start to worry about a debt crisis. Currently, bond vigilantes are active in Japan and the UK, and the U.S. market is beginning to show signs of agitation.

paras: 美元周三(26日)上漲，美國7月通膨數據好壞參半，使外匯市場參與者持續關注聯準會(Fed)的利率路徑。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.3%，報99.16。
美國經濟數據成為當天市場焦點。根據美國經濟分析局(BEA)，廣泛被視為聯準會偏好的通膨指標——核心個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數——7月月增0.2%、年增3.3%，均符合市場預期。月增率較6月加快，而年增率則維持不變。3.3%的年增幅明顯高於聯準會2%的長期目標。
若以整體PCE來看，7月月增0.2%、年增3.7%，略高於市場預期。與核心PCE類似，月增率較6月加快，而年增率則持平。
另外，BEA公布的美國第二季實質國內生產毛額(GDP)第二次估值維持1.5%不變，符合市場共識預期。其他方面，美國人口普查局表示，7月製造業耐久財新訂單增加1.1%，優於預期的0.4%增幅。
綜合這些數據，經濟呈現韌性、通膨仍頑固，讓聯準會在評估更多即將公布的指標時，有更多空間維持利率不變。

paras_en: The dollar rose on Wednesday (the 26th), as mixed July U.S. inflation data kept forex market participants focused on the Federal Reserve's rate path.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, rose 0.3% to 99.16.

U.S. economic data was the day's market focus. According to the Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA), the core personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index – widely seen as the Fed's preferred inflation gauge – rose 0.2% month‑on‑month and 3.3% year‑on‑year in July, both in line with expectations. The monthly pace accelerated from June, while the annual rate held steady. The 3.3% annual increase is well above the Fed’s 2% long‑run target.

Looking at overall PCE, July showed a 0.2% monthly rise and a 3.7% annual increase, slightly above market forecasts. Like core PCE, the monthly gain picked up from June while the yearly figure remained flat.

In addition, the BEA’s second estimate of Q2 real GDP kept the growth rate at 1.5%, matching consensus expectations. Elsewhere, the U.S. Census Bureau reported that July durable‑goods new orders rose 1.1%, beating the anticipated 0.4% increase.
Taken together, the data show a resilient economy and stubborn inflation, giving the Fed more leeway to keep rates unchanged as it evaluates further upcoming indicators.
The CME FedWatch tool reflected this, with market odds of the Fed holding rates steady in September climbing from about 60% a day earlier to nearly 64%.
The dollar rebounded after falling last week.
As the PCE data were released, the U.S. bond market was also experiencing volatility.

Rising oil prices have stoked inflation concerns, and worries that large tech firms are issuing substantial debt to fund AI infrastructure led to a sharp sell‑off of long‑dated U.S. Treasury bonds last week.
The U.S. Treasury unexpectedly intervened, trying to curb yield rises, but the impact was limited after news that U.S. government debt had breached $40 trillion.
Generally, higher Treasury yields act like a rate hike, raising borrowing costs for consumers and businesses and typically supporting a stronger dollar.
However, last week’s debt news sparked doubts about U.S. fiscal health, prompting investors to shift funds from fiat currencies into hard assets such as gold or cryptocurrencies.
The dollar index fell nearly 1% last week, while gold and cryptocurrencies rose.
Market attention now turns to Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s speech on Friday at the annual Jackson Hole conference, where investors will look for further clues on rate policy.
Canadian dollar slumps under tariff pressure

The Canadian dollar resumed its decline against the dollar, with USD/CAD up 0.3% to 1.3877 CAD, as the collapse of U.S.–Canada trade talks and retaliatory tariffs from Washington and Ottawa continued to weigh on the loonie.
The yen weakened, with USD/JPY up 0.1% to 159.34.

After a landmark joint intervention at the end of July, the yen’s rise against the dollar has since retraced about half of that gain but remains below the 160 level, a key threshold watched by Tokyo authorities.
A recent Reuters poll shows a clear majority of economists now expect the Bank of Japan could raise rates as early as September.

The euro fell 0.2% against the dollar to $1.1651 as regional traders digested a hawkish warning from ECB Governing Council member Isabel Schnabel, who said further rate hikes remain necessary despite a sharp drop in energy prices.
The Australian dollar edged up 0.1% to $0.7172 as government data showed mixed inflation signals: July CPI rose 0.6% month‑on‑month but was up 3.5% year‑on‑year, down from 3.8% in June.

items.title_en: Joint Interventions Struggle Against Selling Pressure, Yen Nears 160 Threshold, Japanese Firms Seek 5‑10‑Year “Ultra‑Long‑Term” Hedging
paras: 日元匯率近期再度逼近1美元兌160日元關卡，儘管美日政府曾在2022年、2024年及2026年進行聯合匯市干預，但日元走勢依然疲軟。
日元持續走弱大幅拉高了日本進口商的成本。連鎖超市Takara MC執行長Taku Ueno表示，從美國引進牛肉及從歐洲進口橄欖油等商品的成本日益高昂。Ueno指出，因匯率變動劇烈，美牛價格談判已從每月一次改為每三個月一次，以求延緩終端零售價格上漲。
他認為，「日本正失去購買力」，採購時常面臨中國與泰國買家的競爭，甚至必須親自拜訪供應商求購。此外，日本家具大廠Nitori Holdings估算，日元兌美元每貶值1元，其利潤將縮減約20億日元。
日本經濟新聞編輯委員小栗太指出，雖然官方干預對象主要是避險基金等投機資金，但在日本供需環境改變下，基於實際需求賣出日元的力道正逐步增強。
面對這波匯率波動，日本企業紛紛透過遠期外匯、期貨與選擇權等金融工具進行避險。大和證券執行董事Akira Hirayama透露，過去企業避險多為數月至一年，現已有客戶尋求鎖定長達5至10年的匯率。
推動日元長期貶值的主要因素之一，在於日本相對低利的環境及日本央行緩慢的升息步伐。對於未來走勢，市場仍顯保守。摩根大通日本銷售主管Daiki Hayashi分析，包含境外帳戶在內的多數投資人仍持懷疑態度，主流意見認為日元匯率將維持在155至165區間。
美國銀行外匯銷售主管Namato Nagahama表示，雖然出口商開始考慮避險鎖利，但日元此前一再跌破市場預期的關鍵價位，目前尚難斷定匯率是否已見頂。
paras_en: The yen has again approached the 160 per dollar level, and despite joint market interventions by the U.S. and Japanese governments in 2022, 2024 and 2026, the currency remains weak.

The yen’s continued weakness has sharply raised costs for Japanese importers. Takara MC CEO Taku Ueno said that the cost of importing U.S. beef and European olive oil is soaring. He noted that because of volatile exchange rates, negotiations for U.S. beef have shifted from monthly to once every three months to try to delay retail price hikes.

He believes “Japan is losing purchasing power,” and that procurement often faces competition from Chinese and Thai buyers, sometimes requiring personal visits to suppliers. In addition, furniture giant Nitori Holdings estimates that a one‑yen depreciation against the dollar would cut its profit by about ¥2 billion.

Nikkei editor‑in‑chief Oguri Tai pointed out that while official interventions mainly target hedge funds and other speculative capital, the force of selling yen for genuine demand is gradually strengthening as Japan’s supply‑demand dynamics change.

Facing the currency swing, Japanese companies are hedging with forwards, futures and options. Daiwa Securities executive director Akira Hirayama said that while hedges used to be for a few months to a year, clients are now seeking to lock in rates for as long as five to ten years.

One of the main drivers of the yen’s long‑term decline is Japan’s relatively low‑interest environment and the Bank of Japan’s slow rate‑hiking pace. Looking ahead, markets remain cautious. JPMorgan Japan sales head Daiki Hayashi noted that most investors, including those with offshore accounts, remain skeptical, with the consensus view that the yen will stay in a 155‑165 range.

Bank of America FX sales head Namato Nagahama said that although exporters are beginning to consider hedging to lock in profits, the yen has repeatedly broken key market‑expectation levels, making it still unclear whether the currency has topped out.

items.title_en: Australian Pension Giant Takes Contrarian Bullish Stance on Yen, Bets Heavily Market Underestimates BOJ Rate Hike Prospects
paras: 澳洲第二大退休基金澳洲退休信託(Australian Retirement Trust)(ART)近期逆勢建立多年來最大的日元超配部位，押注市場低估了日本央行(BOJ)的升息前景。
這家管理約 3700 億澳元(約 2650 億美元)退休儲蓄的巨頭，在過去6個月中，隨著日元兌美元跌向 160，持續增加日元曝險，而部分資金來自削減美元的配置。
ART 高級投資組合經理 Jimmy Louca 指出，雖然市場已充分計價能源價格上漲對日元的拖累，但對日本央行升息的預期依然不足。他認為，若這兩個因素逆轉，將為極具價格吸引力的日元提供支撐。
目前互換市場預期日本央行 9 月升息概率約 80%，最遲於 10 月將行動完全定價。Louca 預期，央行可能在下月升息，並可能釋放再升息兩次的信號，這有望推動日本公債殖利率進一步走高，而他預估美元兌日元的公允價值約為 150，甚至可能跌至 140 至 149 的區間。
除了外匯市場，ART 對日本的布局也延伸至股市，於 2026 年 3 月增加了日本股票持倉，並特別聚焦於能直接受益於利率上升的金融板塊。相反地，ART 對美債採取減配約 0.5 個百分點的立場。
Louca 認為，高於目標的通膨、具韌性的增長和 AI 投資熱潮將推高美債殖利率；他並警告，雖然美元仍因儲備貨幣地位而具備重要的避險功能，但試圖壓低名目殖利率的舉措，可能會引發通膨並削弱美元。
paras_en: Australia's second-largest pension fund, Australian Retirement Trust (ART), has recently taken a contrarian stance to build its largest yen overweight position in years, betting that the market is underestimating the Bank of Japan's (BOJ) rate hike prospects.

The giant, which manages approximately AUD 370 billion (about USD 265 billion) in retirement savings, has steadily increased its yen exposure over the past six months as the yen weakened toward 160 against the US dollar, funding part of the move by trimming its US dollar allocation.

ART senior portfolio manager Jimmy Louca noted that while the market has fully priced in the drag on the yen from rising energy prices, expectations for BOJ rate hikes remain insufficient. He believes that a reversal in these two factors would provide support for the yen, which he considers highly attractively valued.

Swap markets currently price in an approximately 80% probability of a BOJ rate hike in September, with action fully priced in by October at the latest. Louca expects the central bank to hike rates next month and potentially signal two further increases, which could push Japanese government bond yields higher. He estimates the fair value of the USD/JPY pair at around 150, with the potential to fall into the 140 to 149 range.

Beyond the foreign exchange market, ART's Japan exposure has also extended to equities, with the fund increasing its Japanese stock holdings in March 2026, particularly focusing on the financial sector, which stands to benefit directly from rising interest rates. Conversely, ART has adopted a stance of underweighting US Treasuries by approximately 0.5 percentage points.

Louca believes that above-target inflation, resilient growth, and the AI investment boom will push US Treasury yields higher. He also warned that while the US dollar retains its important safe-haven status due to its reserve currency role, attempts to suppress nominal yields could spark inflation and weaken the dollar.

美國擴大對伊朗次級制裁範圍，警告各國切斷與伊朗的商業聯繫，否則關鍵企業和實體面臨排出美元金融體系之外風險，藉此切斷支撐伊朗的每一條經濟生命線，伊朗則誓言報復美國擴大經濟制裁，但消費者新聞與商業頻道(CNBC)報導，美國財政部可能動用部分現金餘額回購長期公債，以緩解融資成本壓力，週二導致美元乏力，而且日本財務大臣片山皋月稱，政府將仔細研究提供日本公債散戶投資者稅收優惠，或能填補日本央行(BOJ)減持公債的缺口，成為維持市場穩定關鍵，提供日圓支撐，美元兌日圓下滑至158.99低點。

隨著日本公債收益率大幅上升，今年迄今日本債券交易所交易基金(ETF)吸引創紀錄15億美元淨流入，但BOJ下修7月核心消費者物價指數(CPI)至較上年同期升2.2%，並據共同社報導，日本財務省預計各部門及機構2027財政年預算申請總額首次超過130兆日圓達創紀錄36.64兆日圓，償債成本將升17%，恐加劇財政壓力，引發日圓走貶；此外，美國7月新房屋價格中位數較去年同期創四年新低0.9%及銷售量減10.5%至年率60.7萬戶為1月以來最低，而且美國8月消費者信心指數跌至七個月低點89.4，但波士頓聯邦儲備銀行總裁柯林斯稱若通貨膨脹無持續回落，需盡快加息，而且美國聯邦準備理事會(FED)上月貼現率會議紀錄顯示十二個地區中四家FED董事會支持上調貼現率25個基點，推升美元兌日圓至159.48高點。預估今日美元兌日圓支撐於158.80-159.00，阻力於159.60-80。
◆EUR/USD
昨日澳洲央行(RBA)的8月會議紀錄顯示，九名政策委員對是否加息意見不一，數名認為通貨膨脹存在上行風險，可能有必要加息，但距離加息決定比市場先前預期更近，12月升息的概率升至68%，而且紐西蘭央行(RBNZ)料下周上調25個基點的機率為90%及年底利率進一步升至3.0%，令澳幣和紐元保持堅挺，帶動歐元兌美元穩守1.1650低點。
隨後德國數據顯示，得益於出口及批發和零售貿易領域改善，第二季國內生產總值(GDP)較前季上修至成長0.3%，而且伊福經濟研究所(Ifo)公布德國8月企業景氣判斷與經濟預期指數指數分別升至88.8及89.1超過預期，為德國邁向復甦再添佐證，提振歐元兌美元至1.1679高點。預估今日歐元兌美元阻力於1.1675-95，支撐於1.1600-20。

paras_en: USD/JPY

The United States expanded secondary sanctions on Iran, warning countries to cut commercial ties with Iran or risk key companies and entities being excluded from the dollar financial system, aiming to sever every economic lifeline supporting Iran. Iran vowed retaliation against the expanded U.S. economic sanctions, but CNBC reported that the U.S. Treasury may use part of its cash balances to repurchase long‑term Treasury bonds to ease financing costs. This weakened the dollar on Tuesday, and Japanese Finance Minister Shunichi Suzuki said the government will study tax incentives for retail investors in Japanese government bonds, which could offset the Bank of Japan’s bond‑selling gap and become a key factor in market stability, supporting the yen and pulling USD/JPY down to a low of 158.99.

As Japanese bond yields surged, Japan’s bond‑ETF inflows hit a record $1.5 billion YTD, but the BOJ trimmed the July core CPI forecast to a 2.2% year‑over‑year rise. According to Kyodo, the Finance Ministry expects total budget requests for fiscal 2027 to exceed ¥130 trillion, a record ¥36.64 trillion, pushing debt‑service costs up 17% and threatening fiscal pressure, which could weaken the yen. Meanwhile, U.S. new‑home median prices fell 0.9% YoY to a four‑year low and sales dropped 10.5% to an annualized 607,000 units, the lowest since January. U.S. consumer confidence fell to a seven‑month low of 89.4 in August, and Boston Fed President Collins warned that if inflation does not continue to fall, rate hikes must come quickly. Fed minutes showed four of twelve regional banks’ directors favored a 25‑bp discount‑rate hike, pushing USD/JPY to a high of 159.48. The dollar is expected to find support at 158.80‑159.00 and face resistance at 159.60‑159.80 today.
EUR/USD

Yesterday’s RBA minutes showed nine policy‑makers split on whether to raise rates, with several seeing upside inflation risk and deeming a hike possibly necessary. The probability of a December hike rose to 68%, and the RBNZ is seen 90% likely to lift rates by 25 bps next week and to 3.0% by year‑end, keeping the Aussie and Kiwi strong and anchoring EUR/USD near the 1.1650 low.

German data later showed that, thanks to improvements in exports, wholesale and retail trade, Q2 GDP was revised up to a 0.3% quarterly gain. The Ifo institute lifted its August business climate and expectations indices to 88.8 and 89.1, beating forecasts and adding confidence to Germany’s recovery, which pushed the euro up to a high of 1.1679. EUR/USD is expected to face resistance at 1.1675‑1.1695 and support at 1.1600‑1.1620 today.
GBP/USD

A new round of U.S. sanctions on Iran heightened safe‑haven sentiment, but billionaire investor Derek Miller argued that U.S. Treasury bond buybacks undermine credibility and weigh on the dollar, allowing the pound to hold the 1.3615 low on Tuesday. LSEG data showed markets think better‑than‑expected first‑half data could prompt the BOE to raise rates by at least 25 bps this year, and a Citi‑YouGov poll found public inflation expectations for the next 12 months rose to 3.9% with long‑term expectations hitting a four‑month high of 4.1%, boosting GBP/USD to a high of 1.3654. The pound is expected to face resistance at 1.3650‑1.3670 and support at 1.3560‑1.3580 today.
